overview: 今日共收录72篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Active learning of collinear magnetic moment tensor potentials using the spin-MLIP package from soft-constrained spin-polarized DFT calculations: A case study of Fe–Pd
full_list.title_zh: 使用自旋 MLIP 包从软约束自旋极化 DFT 计算中主动学习共线磁矩张量势：Fe-Pd 的案例研究
full_list.abstract: Publication date: January 2027 Source: Computer Physics Communications, Volume 330 Author(s): Arseniy Burov, Alexey S. Kotykhov, Dmitry A. Aksyonov, Ivan S. Novikov, Vladimir V. Ladygin
full_list.abstract_zh: 出版日期：2027 年 1 月 资料来源：计算机物理通讯，第 330 卷 作者：Arseniy Burov、Alexey S. Kotykhov、Dmitry A. Aksyonov、Ivan S. Novikov、Vladimir V. Ladygin
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 出版日期：2027 年 1 月 资料来源：计算机物理通讯，第 330 卷 作者：Arseniy Burov、Alexey S. Kotykhov、Dmitry A. Aksyonov、Ivan S. Novikov、Vladimir V. Ladygin
full_list.summary: 出版日期：2027 年 1 月 资料来源：计算机物理通讯，第 330 卷 作者：Arseniy Burov、Alexey S. Kotykhov、Dmitry A. Aksyonov、Ivan S. Novikov、Vladimir V. Ladygin
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：主动学习和高通量采样，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《使用自旋 MLIP 包从软约束自旋极化 DFT 计算中主动学习共线磁矩张量势：Fe-Pd 的案例研究》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics Reveals Grotthuss Transport in Concentrated Electrolytes
full_list.title_zh: 机器学习分子动力学揭示了浓电解质中的 Grotthuss 输运
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04558v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Proton transfer is responsible for the anomalous high conductivity in acidic or basic aqueous solutions. Yet, the contribution of the proton transfer mechanism to the conductivity of concentrated aqueous solutions is unknown. In this work, we compute the transport properties of KOH(aq) systems with different concentrations, using Molecular Dynamics simulations with a Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP), which includes proton transfer. We quantify the contribution of the proton transfer mechanism to the diffusivities of hydroxide ions and water molecules, and the ionic conductivity and transport numbers of the electrolytes. The contribution is substantial at lower concentrations, but diminishes at very high concentrations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 质子转移是酸性或碱性水溶液中异常高电导率的原因。然而，质子转移机制对浓水溶液电导率的贡献尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们使用分子动力学模拟和机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)（包括质子转移）来计算不同浓度的 KOH(aq) 系统的输运特性。我们量化了质子转移机制对氢氧根离子和水分子扩散性以及电解质的离子电导率和传输数的贡献。在较低浓度下，贡献很大，但在浓度非常高时，贡献会减弱。

full_list.title_en: Evidence for a Dirac Spin Liquid in the Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet from High-Precision Neural-Network Quantum States
full_list.title_zh: 来自高精度神经网络量子态的 Kagome 海森堡反铁磁体中狄拉克自旋液体的证据
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05174v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet is a central model in the study of quantum spin liquids, yet its ground-state properties remain unresolved. We perform large-scale variational Monte-Carlo calculations using neural-network quantum states (NQSs) with kagome-geometry-aware message-passing convolution on two-dimensional tori containing up to 300 spins, and achieve exceptionally low variational energies for the kagome model. The spin and dimer structure factors show no evidence of magnetic or valence-bond long-range order. Moreover, the dominant symmetry-resolved spin and dimer correlations exhibit a common scaling behavior consistent with the emergent SO(6) monopole multiplet of the Dirac spin liquid. Finally, the fidelity of the optimized NQSs with Gutzwiller-projected mean-field states increasingly favors the Dirac state over the competing Z₂ candidates as the system size grows. Together, these complementary results provide evidence for a U(1) Dirac spin-liquid ground state in the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet.
full_list.abstract_zh: 自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体是量子自旋液体研究的核心模型，但其基态特性仍未得到解决。我们使用神经网络量子态 (NQS) 和 kagome 几何感知消息传递卷积在包含多达 300 个自旋的二维 tori 上执行大规模变分蒙特卡洛计算，并为 kagome 模型实现极低的变分能量。自旋和二聚体结构因子没有显示出磁性或价键长程有序的证据。此外，主要的对称解析自旋和二聚体相关性表现出与狄拉克自旋液体的新兴 SO(6) 单极多重态一致的常见缩放行为。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体是量子自旋液体研究的核心模型，但其基态特性仍未得到解决。我们使用神经网络量子态 (NQS) 和 kagome 几何感知消息传递卷积在包含多达 300 个自旋的二维 tori 上执行大规模变分蒙特卡洛计算，并为 kagome 模型实现极低的变分能量。自旋和二聚体结构因子没有显示出磁性或价键长程有序的证据。此外，主要的对称解析自旋和二聚体相关性表现出与狄拉克自旋液体的新兴 SO(6) 单极多重态一致的常见缩放行为。最后，随着系统规模的增长，具有 Gutzwiller 投影平均场状态的优化 NQS 的保真度越来越有利于狄拉克状态，而不是竞争的 Z2 候选状态。总之，这些互补的结果为 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体中的 U(1) 狄拉克自旋液体基态提供了证据。

full_list.title_en: Benchmarking and advancing machine-learning interatomic potentials for 3C-SiC across equilibrium and extreme conditions
full_list.title_zh: 在平衡和极端条件下对3C-SiC的机器学习原子间电位进行基准测试和推进
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2510.06966v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Several machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have been developed for cubic silicon carbide (3C-SiC). Here, we benchmark seven existing MLIPs against a common set of structural, thermal, defect, radiation-damage, disordered-phase, and computational-performance tests. We also introduce two complementary MLIPs trained on DFT-labeled crystalline, liquid, amorphous, and defective configurations. TGAP, a Gaussian approximation potential based on the verb|soap_turbo| descriptor, provides consistently high accuracy across the sampled configurational space. MTP, a custom moment tensor potential, retains good accuracy across these regimes while offering substantially lower computational cost, GPU acceleration, and access to multi-million-atom simulations. As an application-level test, both potentials remain stable in displacement cascades spanning short-range repulsion, transient disorder, and recrystallization. Overall, MTP emerges as a particularly strong accuracy--cost compromise for large-scale and strongly non-equilibrium simulations of 3C-SiC.
full_list.abstract_zh: 已经针对立方碳化硅 (3C-SiC) 开发了几种机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)。在这里，我们针对一组常见的结构、热、缺陷、辐射损伤、无序相和计算性能测试对七个现有的 MLIP 进行了基准测试。我们还引入了两种互补的 MLIP，它们经过 DFT 标记的晶体、液体、无定形和缺陷配置的训练。 TGAP，基于动词 |soap_turbo| 的高斯近似势描述符，在采样的配置空间中提供一致的高精度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 已经针对立方碳化硅 (3C-SiC) 开发了几种机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)。在这里，我们针对一组常见的结构、热、缺陷、辐射损伤、无序相和计算性能测试对七个现有的 MLIP 进行了基准测试。我们还引入了两种互补的 MLIP，它们经过 DFT 标记的晶体、液体、无定形和缺陷配置的训练。 TGAP，基于动词 |soap_turbo| 的高斯近似势描述符，在采样的配置空间中提供一致的高精度。 MTP 是一种自定义矩张量势，在这些机制中保持良好的准确性，同时提供显着降低的计算成本、GPU 加速以及对数百万原子模拟的访问。作为应用级测试，两种电势在跨越短程排斥、瞬态无序和再结晶的位移级联中保持稳定。总体而言，MTP 对于 3C-SiC 的大规模和强非平衡模拟来说是一种特别强的精度和成本折衷方案。
full_list.summary: 已经针对立方碳化硅 (3C-SiC) 开发了几种机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)。在这里，我们针对一组常见的结构、热、缺陷、辐射损伤、无序相和计算性能测试对七个现有的 MLIP 进行了基准测试。我们还引入了两种互补的 MLIP，它们经过 DFT 标记的晶体、液体、无定形和缺陷配置的训练。 TGAP，基于动词 |soap_turbo| 的高斯近似势描述符，在采样的配置空间中提供一致的高精度。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《在平衡和极端条件下对3C-SiC的机器学习原子间电位进行基准测试和推进》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Small-data physics-informed ML model for magnetic exchange based on chemical composition and structure
full_list.title_zh: 基于化学成分和结构的磁交换小数据物理信息机器学习模型
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04681v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper we propose an ensemble model based on a swarm of dense neural networks, able to predict Heisenberg exchange interactions within less than 1% error. The model uses the inputs of the ab-initio Schrödinger equation, i.e. the compound structure and chemical composition. In this first work, we trained the model on a few compounds of the hexagonal manganite family and were able to infer, with similar accuracy, the J values for other compounds of the same family at randomly chosen geometries, thus showing that we accurately learned the effect of the chemical composition and structure on effective magnetic integrals J.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种基于密集神经网络群的集成模型，能够以小于 1% 的误差预测海森堡交换相互作用。该模型使用从头算薛定谔方程的输入，即化合物结构和化学成分。在第一项工作中，我们对六方锰酸盐家族的几种化合物训练了模型，并能够以类似的精度推断出随机选择几何形状的同一家族其他化合物的 J 值，从而表明我们准确地了解了化学成分和结构对有效磁积分 J 的影响。

full_list.title_en: A Two-Dimensional Physics-Informed Neural Network Model of a Hall Effect Thruster Plasma: Self-Consistent Electrostatics and Physical-Consistency Diagnostics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Two-Dimensional Physics-Informed Neural Network Model of a Hall Effect Thruster Plasma: Self-Consistent Electrostatics and Physical-Consistency Diagnostics
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a two-dimensional axisymmetric physics-informed neural network (PINN) of the discharge channel of the P5 Hall thruster at 300 V and 5.4 A, which solves eleven coupled plasma fields and assimilates 145 internal probe measurements per field reconstructed from the data of Haas and Gallimore. The electric potential is obtained from Poisson's equation in charge-separation form, nₑ = nᵢ(1+eta), with eta bounded by construction, which keeps the stiff electrostatic constraint active and trainable. The reference solution agrees with the training profiles to relative L2 errors of 0.017, 0.073 and 0.205 for the potential, electron temperature and ion density, and held-out tests show the potential to be far more robust than the ion density to the withdrawal of measurement lines. We then test the solution against requirements the data fit does not reveal: global particle and current balances, the electron current implied by the momentum equation, the field-aligned electron force balance and the axial ion momentum budget. These expose a neutral inflow six times the measured flow, a bound in the potential representation, and a momentum-implied electron current, more than 99% field-aligned, exceeding the discharge current by orders of magnitude. Correcting these, with a divergence-free magnetic field fitted to measured data, uncertainty-weighted data, the electron pressure gradient and progressively imposed field-aligned and current constraints, yields a solution that conserves particles to within 3%, holds the current between 5.1 and 5.4 A and places 97% of the potential and 88% of the temperature measurements within their uncertainties. Within the tested single-velocity fluid formulation, however, the ion density, potential and ion velocity could not be matched together, and the field-aligned electron balance remains the main obstacle to electron self-consistency.

full_list.title_en: A local orchestration harness for molecular design with foundation models
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A local orchestration harness for molecular design with foundation models
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular design requires coordinated generation, property prediction and iterative editing, with each decision linked to the correct chemical structure and supporting evidence. Integrating these capabilities in practice presents three major challenges: retaining local control of molecular data, connecting specialized models across tasks and verifying that proposed changes satisfy chemical constraints. Here we present MolCrew, a locally deployable system that coordinates four separately trained molecular specialists with a language-model orchestrator and RDKit calculations. The specialists generate structures from descriptions, describe molecular structures, predict biological endpoints and propose edits towards specified goals. Separate model weights allow each capability to be evaluated and updated independently within the workflow. RDKit calculations check structural validity, quantify descriptor changes and assess specified structural constraints, while returned observations guide further tool calls. We evaluated low-rank adaptation of the orchestrator for tool-use decisions and failure recovery while leaving specialist weights unchanged. On 3,300 ChEBI-20 test examples, MolCrew achieved 96.4% exact structure recovery, compared with 38.7% for published Atomas-large results. Across eight MoleculeNet datasets evaluated using scaffold splits, mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.851, compared with 0.770 for published Atomas results. In a recorded evaluation using the unadapted orchestrator, 1,554 of 1,699 requests (91.5%) passed every predefined workflow check. By preserving inspectable links between molecular proposals, model outputs and chemical calculations, MolCrew provides a modular framework for computational candidate assessment and refinement under local data control.

full_list.title_en: Quantifying out-of-distribution data severity with Wasserstein distances: benchmarking large language models for alloy property prediction
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantifying out-of-distribution data severity with Wasserstein distances: benchmarking large language models for alloy property prediction
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03767v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs), such as Gemini and DeepSeek, exhibit increasingly advanced reasoning capabilities, a critical question arises: how do their property prediction abilities compare to those of domain-specific pretrained materials models? In this study, we evaluate predictions for Ti, steels, high-entropy alloy (HEA) and Al, demonstrating that general-purpose LLMs surprisingly outperform SteelBERT, MatSciBERT, and SciBERT. To further enhance performance, we introduce a hybrid approach that utilizes numerical priors from a prior model, such as CatBoost or SteelBERT, to guide the general LLMs (Deepseek V3.1, Gemini-2.5-Flash). By inputting these initial estimates from a prior model as prompts, the LLM acts as a reasoning corrector, achieving accuracy superior to the prior model and "unguided mode". Furthermore, we investigate the impact of data strategy using a similarity-based metric, revealing that data quality dominates quantity; using merely 5% of high-similarity reference data of training set as input yields performance similar to the results of using 100% of training set. Additionally, the LLMs demonstrate excellent uncertainty calibration, where self-reported "high" confidence strongly correlates with minimal deviation from ground truth. Our findings suggest that synergizing general-purpose LLMs with prior model numerical baselines and high-quality data curation creates a cost-effective and accurate paradigm for materials discovery, reducing the need for expensive domain-specific pretraining.

full_list.title_en: Surrogate Models for Stochastic Al-Cu Phase-Field Solidification
full_list.title_zh: 随机 Al-Cu 相场凝固的替代模型
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04695v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Phase-field models resolve microstructural evolution during rapid alloy solidification, but their computational cost limits long trajectories, stochastic ensembles, and studies across process conditions. We present a variance-preserving denoising diffusion bridge model (VP-DDBM) for state-conditioned prediction of two-dimensional Al-Cu solidification. Given the current phase, concentration, and prescribed temperature fields, the model predicts the subsequent state and is applied autoregressively. Across two held-out thermal gradients, VP-DDBM produces lower long-horizon errors than deterministic U-Net and SI-ConvNeXt baselines in domain-mean phase, domain-mean Cu concentration, and leading-tip position. It also retains fine dendritic structure over long rollouts, whereas the deterministic U-Net progressively smooths the morphology. VP-DDBM predicts the phase and concentration evolution approximately 73× faster than the phase-field solver, showing potential for faster process-condition screening and ensemble-based microstructure studies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 相场模型解决了合金快速凝固过程中的微观结构演化问题，但其计算成本限制了长轨迹、随机系综和跨工艺条件的研究。我们提出了一种用于二维 Al-Cu 凝固状态条件预测的保方差降噪扩散桥模型 (VP-DDBM)。给定当前相位、浓度和规定的温度场，该模型可以预测后续状态并以自回归方式应用。在两个保持的热梯度中，VP-DDBM 在域平均相位、域平均 Cu 浓度和前导尖端位置方面产生的长视野误差比确定性 U-Net 和 SI-ConvNeXt 基线更低。

full_list.title_en: When do machine-learning potentials need a configuration-dependent kernel? Learning long-range interactions with Fourier neural operators
full_list.title_zh: 机器学习潜力何时需要依赖于配置的内核？学习与傅立叶神经算子的远程交互
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-range interactions in machine-learning interatomic potentials are commonly treated by coupling learned sources through either a prescribed electrostatic kernel or a learned but configuration-independent one. Whether such a kernel suffices depends on the underlying screened interaction. We address this question by using Fourier neural operators (FNOs) to learn how latent source fields, built from the descriptors of a local backbone (here MACE), interact across the simulation cell. For a synthetic ionic system with tunable screening, a prescribed Coulomb kernel underestimates the long-wavelength charge fluctuations by 43% under strong screening, whereas the FNO reproduces them within 3% and recovers 95-99% of the variance of the residual left by the local backbone. A linear FNO, which learns a configuration-independent kernel, performs equally well in the homogeneous case. Under inhomogeneous screening, rearranging the remote medium modulates the coupling between distant ions, a dependence that no configuration-independent kernel can represent. Among the models tested, only the nonlinear FNO responds to this modulation, and its force errors are 27-41% lower than those of configuration-independent models. In first-principles benchmarks of liquid water, lithium lanthanum zirconate, and Au2/MgO(001), MACE-FNO is comparable to a prescribed-kernel model for the bulk systems and more accurate for the interface. It further captures the reversal of the Au2 wetting preference induced by remote Al dopants, with deviations below 5 meV per cell from density functional theory. These results indicate that a configuration-dependent kernel, as learned by FNOs, becomes necessary once the screening medium varies, even though the energy remains quadratic in the charges for a fixed medium.
full_list.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势中的长程相互作用通常通过通过规定的静电核或学习但与配置无关的核耦合学习源来处理。这样的内核是否足够取决于底层的屏蔽交互。我们通过使用傅里叶神经算子 (FNO) 来解决这个问题，以了解根据本地骨干网（此处为 MACE）的描述符构建的潜在源场如何在模拟单元中相互作用。对于具有可调谐屏蔽的合成离子系统，规定的库仑核在强屏蔽下将长波长电荷波动低估了 43%，而 FNO 在 3% 内再现了它们，并恢复了本地主干留下的残差方差的 95-99%。

full_list.title_en: Isothermal-Isobaric Molecular Dynamics with a Foundation Interatomic Potential in LAMMPS across NVIDIA and Intel GPUs
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Isothermal-Isobaric Molecular Dynamics with a Foundation Interatomic Potential in LAMMPS across NVIDIA and Intel GPUs
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) offer one model for many chemistries, but their deep, globally coupled architectures do not fit the spatial decomposition that scales classical and short-ranged MLIPs. We present pair_style uma, a LAMMPS pair style that evaluates the Universal Model for Atoms (UMA) through LibTorch on NVIDIA and Intel GPUs from a single source tree. It reimplements FairChem's edge-sharded graph parallelism in C++ over exported TorchScript modules, with one MPI rank per device, NCCL or oneCCL collectives, and the whole energy and force path in double precision. The strain-gradient virial is carried through the exported modules and the cross-device reductions, so that fix npt runs on both vendors' hardware. We measure NPT capacity and cost on one 4xA100-40GB node, one 8xH200 node, and one 12-tile Intel node, and on up to 32 Intel nodes. Without activation checkpointing, one node holds NaCl cells of about 8,000 atoms (A100, 0.21 ns/day), 22,000 atoms (Intel, 0.10 ns/day), and 47,000 atoms (H200, 0.16 ns/day). Graph parallelism raises the capacity of a single device by 8.0x on H200 and 4.6x on A100. Across nodes, capacity grows to about 779,000 atoms on 32 Intel nodes, with a slower speed at 0.007 ns/day. On H200 and A100, a FLOP count of FairChem's graph-parallel predictor gives lower bounds of 31% and 51% of FP64 peak. From one omat checkpoint and with no refit, nine 100 ps NPT heating ramps (NaCl, equiatomic Pt-Ru, and equiatomic (HfNbTaTiZr)N, on all three node types) ran to completion.

full_list.title_en: LaQX: A JAX Toolkit for Neural Quantum State Simulations of Lattice Quantum Many-Body Models
full_list.title_zh: LaQX：用于晶格量子多体模型神经量子态模拟的 JAX 工具包
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural quantum states provide accurate variational representations for interacting lattice fermions and spins. Turning a new ansatz into a reproducible calculation, however, requires coordinated implementations of the Hamiltonian, sampling, optimization, observables, and accelerator parallelism. We present LaQX (Lattice Quantum simulation based on jaX), an open-source neural quantum state library based on JAX that organizes these components through common functional interfaces. Beyond ground-state variational Monte Carlo, LaQX supports excited-state calculations, Green's Function Monte Carlo refinement, adiabatic evolution, and real-time evolution with time-dependent variational Monte Carlo. It consolidates methods developed in recent high-accuracy neural quantum state studies of the Hubbard model and frustrated magnets, and the package has been used to investigate the triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model. We document these capabilities with reproducible calculations for Hubbard, J₁-J₂ Heisenberg, altermagnetic Hubbard, and interacting Hofstadter models. Function-oriented modules separate the scientific components and limit the source context needed for extensions by human developers and large language models. Source code, documentation, and executable examples are available at https://github.com/bytedance/laqx.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量, 蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Toward Intelligent Thermal Fluids: AI-Driven Design of Zeta-Engineered Nanofluids and Self-Organized Thermal Transport Networks
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Toward Intelligent Thermal Fluids: AI-Driven Design of Zeta-Engineered Nanofluids and Self-Organized Thermal Transport Networks
full_list.abstract: The development of next-generation nanofluids requires a shift from empirical formulation approaches toward data-driven design strategies that simultaneously optimize thermal conductivity, dynamic viscosity, stability, and system-level performance. This perspective highlights the emerging convergence of artificial intelligence (AI), zeta-potential (ZP) engineering, and advanced nanomaterials for the design of intelligent thermal fluids. Particular emphasis is placed on ZP-engineered nanofluids, in which electrostatic interactions are deliberately tailored to control nanoparticle dispersion, stability, and the formation of self-organized thermal transport networks. While interconnected nanoparticle networks can enhance thermal transport, excessive network connectivity, especially in high-aspect-ratio nanomaterials such as carbon nanotubes and graphene derivatives, may increase the dynamic viscosity and hydraulic resistance. Therefore, optimal nanofluid design requires balancing competing thermophysical and operational objectives under application-specific conditions. An AI-driven framework integrating machine learning, physics-informed machine learning, explainable AI, active learning, and multi-objective optimization is presented to accelerate nanofluid discovery and optimization. A representative case study of ZP-engineered iron oxide-carbon nanotube-graphene oxide nanofluids demonstrates the use of data-driven modeling, feature-importance analysis, SHAP interpretation, and Pareto optimization. The integration of AI-guided optimization with ZP-controlled network engineering provides a promising pathway toward intelligent thermal fluids and autonomous materials discovery for advanced thermal management systems.

full_list.title_en: De Rham cohomological architectures for PINNs and PDEs with topological holes
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：De Rham cohomological architectures for PINNs and PDEs with topological holes
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05276v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We attempt to alleviate failure modes of classical physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) in scenarios of topological pathologies corresponding to punctures, holes, poles, and voids by introducing de Rham cohomological augmentations, or Hodge-de Rham PINNs. Vanilla PINNs often encounter pitfalls in hole-based settings due to discontinuous interfaces, nonzero closed path integration, path dependence, correspondence to exact forms via the exterior derivative, etc., therefore we absolve traditional failures via parameterizing a 1-form by the Hodge-Morrey-Friedrichs (HMF) decomposition for manifolds with boundary, drawing a connection to de Rham cohomology such as through the HMF isomorphism theorem. 1-forms can act as representations of scalar-valued PDE solutions through integral operator mappings. We propose performing a PINN-based loss on the parameterized 1-form through an associated PDE, which subsequently solves the potential-based PINN problem and moreover remedies the failures of vanilla PINNs via the Sobolev-regular operator under a Fréchet differentiation interconnection. The operator relationship often has a nontrivial closed-form and often requires integration or a case-by-case analysis, which we address thoroughly in our experiments. When an integrability condition is not met on our losses, we can equip exhaustion functions to train the networks. We demonstrate our methods on the Aharonov-Bohm effect, which, to our understanding, is largely nonexistent in PINN literature. We develop theoretical guarantees of our methods and demonstrate our pathological safeguards on a broad selection of topologically-adverse problems, including scenarios of inexact forms, and those of nontrivial harmonics and coexact terms.

full_list.title_en: NovoCRF: Globally Normalized De Novo Peptide Sequencing on a Prefix-Mass Lattice
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：NovoCRF: Globally Normalized De Novo Peptide Sequencing on a Prefix-Mass Lattice
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: De novo peptide sequencing has moved from dynamic programming over hand-designed or generative scores to large transformers that learn the task end to end. We present NovoCRF, a conditional random field (CRF) whose states are prefix masses, so that its paths are exactly the peptides within +/-0.06 Da of the precursor mass. A small network scores each edge from physics-derived ion-match features and is trained with its scores globally normalized over all mass-feasible peptides. To our knowledge, NovoCRF is the first de novo method trained with exact normalization over all mass-feasible peptides. Our software has three modules, each with exactly one job: a precursor mass finder recovers the accurate precursor mass from MS1, the CRF finds the peptides that fit the precursor mass by exact k-best decoding, and two BiGRU rerankers add sequence context and internal-fragment evidence. The model has 310k parameters and trains in about 17 GPU-hours. On seven held-out data-dependent acquisition datasets published in 2026 (126,262 labeled spectra), NovoCRF's mean peptide recall is 42.4%, against 39.1% for Casanovo v5 with five beams, and its amino-acid recall 64.0% against 53.1%, at 1,746 spectra/s on 18 CPU threads, 55x Casanovo's throughput on a GPU. Split by fragment evidence, NovoCRF leads on labels with up to three peptide bonds without a b or y ion, and Casanovo only beyond. NovoCRF can also search modifications it was never trained on at their exact mass: it finds 32.1% of the hydroxyproline peptides of a lion bone sample.

full_list.title_en: Vortices in a two-dimensional fermionic superfluid
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Vortices in a two-dimensional fermionic superfluid
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantized vortices are a hallmark of superfluidity. They have proven to be an indispensable probe for systems ranging from superfluid helium to type-II superconductors. In ultracold two-dimensional (2D) Fermi gases, where phase fluctuations are enhanced and the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) mechanism governs the superfluid transition, their observation has remained elusive. Here, we report on the controlled creation of quantized vortices in a homogeneous 2D gas in the BEC--BCS crossover. By continuously tuning the velocity of two moving obstacles, we observe quantized steps in the absolute vortex charge. Matter-wave interferometry reveals the characteristic phase winding, quantized in units of 2π. Measurements on 2D and 3D gases show a striking difference: only in 2D does the vortex number grow with temperature, reflecting thermal activation of BKT vortex pairs. Our approach provides evidence of fermionic superfluidity in 2D and offers a means to study BKT physics, vortex-controlled transport and resistance, as well as to detect unconventional superfluidity in spin-imbalanced 2D gases.

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Vortices in a two-dimensional fermionic superfluid》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Agentic inverse design of spatially programmed materials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Agentic inverse design of spatially programmed materials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatially programmed functional materials, from functionally graded alloys and metamaterials to quantum superlattices, use their spatial structure to tailor physical properties. However, translating a desired spatial structure into a practical fabrication recipe remains challenging due to the complex relationship between processing conditions and resulting material structures. Here we show that a large language model (LLM) agent can inverse-design such fabrication recipes by using a physics-based simulator of ion-matter interactions as a tool. Given an arbitrary depth profile of implanted ions or vacancies, the agent selects the ion species, energies, incident angles, and target material layers; writes, runs, and interprets simulations; and iteratively refines the recipe until the simulated profile matches the target, with minimal human input. Our work demonstrates physics-guided agentic inverse design as a practical approach to making the spatial structure of materials a programmable variable, opening new opportunities to explore emergent physical phenomena and functional phases of matter.

full_list.title_en: Altermagnetism-induced Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov superfluids and momentum-selective pairing channels in optical lattices
full_list.title_zh: 交变磁力诱导的 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov 超流体和光学晶格中的动量选择性配对通道
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the superfluid phases of a two-dimensional degenerate Fermi gas in an optical lattice subject to a dₓy-wave altermagnetic term that couples to the in-plane spin component. The single-particle Hamiltonian generates anisotropic Fermi surfaces for the two pseudo-spin species while maintaining zero net polarization. Using the Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach, we show that this anisotropy favors Cooper pairing at a finite center-of-mass momentum, producing a competition between Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) and Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) pairing and leading to FFLO superfluids. We further examine the effect of a Zeeman-induced spin polarization and find that triplet and singlet pairing channels coexist and compete, resulting in a momentum-selective pairing pattern. Remarkably, this triplet pairing emerges exclusively in the FFLO phase and is entirely absent in the BCS phase. The model is readily realizable in ultracold atoms with current experimental techniques, providing a feasible route for quantum emulation and for studying unconventional superfluid phases.

full_list.title_en: Loss of altermagnetic order and smooth restoration of Kramers' spin degeneracy with increasing temperature in CrSb and MnTe
full_list.title_zh: CrSb和MnTe中随温度升高而变化的磁序的丧失和Kramers自旋退化的平稳恢复
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.15035v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We describe how thermally induced spin fluctuations modify the electronic structures of two prototypical altermagnets, CrSb and MnTe, via application of the disordered local moment picture. For both materials, our self-consistent, ab initio calculations demonstrate that local magnetic moments persist on Cr and Mn atoms in their paramagnetic states, necessitating a spin-polarised description of the electronic structure even above the Néel temperature, T_N. Moreover, Kramers' spin degeneracy, which is broken for both materials in their altermagnetic ground states, is shown to be smoothly restored - on the average - as the local moments thermally disorder. In metallic CrSb, this occurs at temperatures well below T_N and the signature effects of its altermagnetism are lost as the magnetic disorder induces heavy smearing of strongly dispersive electronic states around the Fermi energy. By contrast, in semiconducting MnTe, with its band gap largely unaffected by magnetic disorder, the spin degeneracy only returns at temperatures close to and above T_N. We quantify the temperature dependence of the altermagnetic order parameter and the underlying electronic structures of both materials, with implications for their spin transport and spectroscopic properties.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们描述了热诱导的自旋波动如何通过应用无序局部矩图来改变两个典型替代磁体CrSb和MnTe的电子结构。对于这两种材料，我们自洽的从头计算表明， Cr和Mn原子在顺磁状态下存在局部磁矩，需要对电子结构进行自旋极化描述，甚至高于Néel温度T_N。此外，克莱默斯的自旋退化（ Kramers 'spin degeneracy ）在两种材料的变磁基态下都被打破，平均而言，随着局部时刻的热紊乱，克莱默斯的自旋退化被平稳地恢复。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们描述了热诱导的自旋波动如何通过应用无序局部矩图来改变两个典型替代磁体CrSb和MnTe的电子结构。对于这两种材料，我们自洽的从头计算表明， Cr和Mn原子在顺磁状态下存在局部磁矩，需要对电子结构进行自旋极化描述，甚至高于Néel温度T_N。此外，克莱默斯的自旋退化（ Kramers 'spin degeneracy ）在两种材料的变磁基态下都被打破，平均而言，随着局部时刻的热紊乱，克莱默斯的自旋退化被平稳地恢复。在金属CrSb中，这发生在远低于T_N的温度下，并且其改变磁性的特征效应丢失，因为磁性紊乱导致费米能周围强色散电子态的严重涂抹。相比之下，在半导体MnTe中，其带隙基本上不受磁性紊乱的影响，自旋退化仅在接近或高于T_N的温度下返回。我们量化了两种材料的替代有序参数和基础电子结构的温度依赖性，并对其自旋传输和光谱性质产生影响。

full_list.title_en: Chiral Phonons Coupled to Spin-Split Bands in Altermagnetic CrSb and MnTe
full_list.title_zh: 手性声子耦合到Altermagnetic CrSb和MnTe中的自旋分裂带
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.04802v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, providing a unique platform where magnetic order, electronic structure and lattice dynamics intertwine. Here, using first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the prototypical altermagnets CrSb and MnTe host locally chiral phonon modes carrying finite phonon angular momentum with a six-lobes f-wave texture in momentum space. Our results show that the chiral lattice motion originates from the pnictogen/chalcogen sublattice, while the altermagnetic spin splitting is generated by the magnetic transition-metal atoms, indicating that chiral lattice dynamics and altermagnetic electronic states originate from different atomic sublattices of the same crystal. In pristine compounds, at each valley, inversion symmetry suppresses the net phonon angular momentum despite local circular atomic motion. We further demonstrate that isoelectronic symmetry lowering induced by chemical substitution lifts this cancellation and generates finite valley phonon chirality, while keeping the altermagnetic nature of the compounds intact. Most importantly, we reveal that chiral phonons couple to momentum-dependent spin-split electronic bands through momentum-dependent electron-phonon interaction, producing characteristic modifications of the electronic structure, possibly accessible by photoemission experiments. Our results establish altermagnets as a promising platform for chiral phononics and spin-selective lattice control.
full_list.abstract_zh: Altermagnet表现出动量依赖的自旋分裂，没有净磁化，提供了一个独特的平台，磁序、电子结构和晶格动力学交织在一起。在这里，使用第一原理计算，我们证明了原型改变磁体CrSb和MnTe在动量空间中承载有限声子角动量的局部手性声子模，具有六瓣f波纹理。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: Altermagnet表现出动量依赖的自旋分裂，没有净磁化，提供了一个独特的平台，磁序、电子结构和晶格动力学交织在一起。在这里，使用第一原理计算，我们证明了原型改变磁体CrSb和MnTe在动量空间中承载有限声子角动量的局部手性声子模，具有六瓣f波纹理。我们的结果表明，手性晶格运动起源于pnictogen/chalcogen亚晶格，而altermagnetic自旋分裂是由磁性过渡金属原子产生的，这表明手性晶格动力学和altermagnetic电子态起源于同一晶体的不同原子亚晶格。在原始化合物中，在每个山谷，反转对称性抑制了净声子角动量，尽管局部环形原子运动。我们进一步证明，由化学取代引起的等电子对称性降低提升了这种抵消，并产生了有限谷声子手性，同时保持了化合物的改变磁性。最重要的是，我们揭示了手性声子通过动量依赖性电子-声子相互作用与动量依赖性自旋分裂电子带耦合，产生电子结构的特征修改，可能通过光发射实验获得。我们的研究结果确立了Altermagnets作为手性声子和自旋选择晶格控制的有前途的平台。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化, 电子—声子耦合与输运，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: An Atlas of Classical Pyrochlore Spin Liquids
full_list.title_zh: 经典烧绿石旋转液体图集
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2411.03547v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Frustrated magnetism in the pyrochlore lattice magnet has proven to be a most fruitful setting for the experimental and theoretical search for spin liquids. Besides the canonical case of spin ice, recent works have identified a variety of new classical and quantum spin liquids engendered by the generic nearest-neighbor anisotropic spin Hamiltonian for that lattice. However, a general framework for the thorough and systematic classification and characterization of these exotic states of matter has been lacking, as has an exhaustive list of all possible spin liquids that this model can support and, perhaps most interesting, what is the corresponding structure of their emergent field theory description. In this work, we develop such a theoretical framework to identify the interaction parameters stabilizing different classical spin liquids and derive their corresponding effective generalized Gauss's laws at low temperatures. Combining this with Monte Carlo simulations, we systematically identify all classical spin liquids for the general nearest-neighbor anisotropic spin Hamiltonian on the pyrochlore lattice. In doing so, we uncover new spin liquid models with exotic forms of generalized Gauss's law and multipole conservation laws. Our approach allows us to compile an atlas of all spin liquids realized in the phase diagram, providing a global picture of their mutual connections in parameter space and transitions between them. Our work will inform future theoretical and experimental studies of classical and quantum spin liquids on the pyrochlore lattice and help rationalize the exotic properties of pyrochlore magnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 烧绿石晶格磁体中的受挫磁性已被证明是自旋液体的实验和理论研究中最富有成果的环境。除了自旋冰的典型情况之外，最近的工作还发现了由该晶格的通用最近邻各向异性自旋哈密顿量产生的各种新的经典和量子自旋液体。然而，一直缺乏对这些奇异物质状态进行彻底、系统分类和表征的通用框架，以及该模型可以支持的所有可能的自旋液体的详尽列表，也许最有趣的是，它们的新兴场论描述的相应结构是什么。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 烧绿石晶格磁体中的受挫磁性已被证明是自旋液体的实验和理论研究中最富有成果的环境。除了自旋冰的典型情况之外，最近的工作还发现了由该晶格的通用最近邻各向异性自旋哈密顿量产生的各种新的经典和量子自旋液体。然而，一直缺乏对这些奇异物质状态进行彻底、系统分类和表征的通用框架，以及该模型可以支持的所有可能的自旋液体的详尽列表，也许最有趣的是，它们的新兴场论描述的相应结构是什么。在这项工作中，我们开发了这样一个理论框架来识别稳定不同经典自旋液体的相互作用参数，并推导出它们在低温下相应的有效广义高斯定律。将此与蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，我们系统地识别了烧绿石晶格上一般最近邻各向异性自旋哈密顿量的所有经典自旋液体。在此过程中，我们发现了具有奇异形式的广义高斯定律和多极守恒定律的新自旋液体模型。我们的方法使我们能够编译相图中实现的所有自旋液体的图集，提供它们在参数空间中的相互连接以及它们之间的转换的全局图片。我们的工作将为未来对烧绿石晶格上的经典和量子自旋液体的理论和实验研究提供信息，并有助于合理化烧绿石磁体的奇异特性。

full_list.title_en: Anomalous Hall Response and Real-Space Current Correlations in Rhombohedral Graphene
full_list.title_zh: 菱面体石墨烯中的反常霍尔响应和实空间电流相关性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04312v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and magnetization observed in rhombohedral graphene through real-space calculations which lead to new insights. Our calculations reveal no equilibrium loop currents of the type associated with the Haldane model of a quantum anomalous Hall insulator. Instead, the AHE arises in this instance from interference between electronic paths forming oriented closed Wilson loops of current operators in the presence of valley polarization. We show some examples of these Wilson loops. Using the fact that the added-carrier charge density resides dominantly in the top and bottom layers, we develop a real-space expansion of the surface Hamiltonian that reproduces the Hall response of the full model with good accuracy. We also predict that a smooth local potential induces equilibrium circulating currents whose strength depends on both Berry curvature and the orbital moments of states at the Fermi surface.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们通过实空间计算研究了菱面体石墨烯中观察到的反常霍尔效应（AHE）和磁化强度，从而得出新的见解。我们的计算表明，不存在与量子反常霍尔绝缘体霍尔丹模型相关的类型的平衡环路电流。相反，在这种情况下，AHE 是由于在存在谷极化的情况下形成电流算子的定向闭合威尔逊环的电子路径之间的干扰而产生的。我们展示了这些威尔逊环的一些示例。利用添加载流子电荷密度主要存在于顶层和底层的事实，我们开发了表面哈密顿量的实空间扩展，可以高精度地再现整个模型的霍尔响应。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过实空间计算研究了菱面体石墨烯中观察到的反常霍尔效应（AHE）和磁化强度，从而得出新的见解。我们的计算表明，不存在与量子反常霍尔绝缘体霍尔丹模型相关的类型的平衡环路电流。相反，在这种情况下，AHE 是由于在存在谷极化的情况下形成电流算子的定向闭合威尔逊环的电子路径之间的干扰而产生的。我们展示了这些威尔逊环的一些示例。利用添加载流子电荷密度主要存在于顶层和底层的事实，我们开发了表面哈密顿量的实空间扩展，可以高精度地再现整个模型的霍尔响应。我们还预测，平滑的局部势能引起平衡环流，其强度取决于贝里曲率和费米表面状态的轨道矩。

full_list.title_en: Hydrogen-induced modification of the local charge density in MnSb₂Te₄
full_list.title_zh: 氢诱导改变 MnSb2Te₄ 中的局部电荷密度
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04649v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the effects of ionic hydrogen (H⁺) intake on the occupied and unoccupied states of MnSb₂Te₄, a van der Waals magnetic material. Using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and time-resolved ARPES, combined with resonant and core level photoemission, we reveal that hydrogen binds near specific lattice sites, locally redistributing charge density and reshaping the valence band spectral weight. While the band gap and picosecond carrier dynamics show only minor changes upon hydrogenation, the conduction band exhibits a striking stoichiometry-dependent response. These findings indicate that hydrogen interacts strongly with the intrinsic defects in the lattice, acting as a selective dopant in MnSb₂Te₄. Our work provides a spectroscopic basis for using hydrogen as a tool for the control of the electronic and magnetic properties in layered 2D materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了离子氢 (H⁺) 摄入量对范德华磁性材料 MnSb2Te₄ 的占据和未占据状态的影响。利用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 和时间分辨 ARPES，结合共振和核心能级光电子发射，我们揭示了氢在特定晶格位点附近结合，局部重新分布电荷密度并重塑价带光谱权重。虽然带隙和皮秒载流子动力学在氢化时仅显示出微小的变化，但导带表现出惊人的化学计量依赖性响应。这些发现表明氢与晶格中的固有缺陷强烈相互作用，充当 MnSb2Te4 中的选择性掺杂剂。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了离子氢 (H⁺) 摄入量对范德华磁性材料 MnSb2Te₄ 的占据和未占据状态的影响。利用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 和时间分辨 ARPES，结合共振和核心能级光电子发射，我们揭示了氢在特定晶格位点附近结合，局部重新分布电荷密度并重塑价带光谱权重。虽然带隙和皮秒载流子动力学在氢化时仅显示出微小的变化，但导带表现出惊人的化学计量依赖性响应。这些发现表明氢与晶格中的固有缺陷强烈相互作用，充当 MnSb2Te4 中的选择性掺杂剂。我们的工作为使用氢作为控制层状二维材料的电子和磁性的工具提供了光谱基础。
full_list.summary: 我们研究了离子氢 (H⁺) 摄入量对范德华磁性材料 MnSb2Te₄ 的占据和未占据状态的影响。利用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 和时间分辨 ARPES，结合共振和核心能级光电子发射，我们揭示了氢在特定晶格位点附近结合，局部重新分布电荷密度并重塑价带光谱权重。虽然带隙和皮秒载流子动力学在氢化时仅显示出微小的变化，但导带表现出惊人的化学计量依赖性响应。这些发现表明氢与晶格中的固有缺陷强烈相互作用，充当 MnSb2Te4 中的选择性掺杂剂。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《氢诱导改变 MnSb2Te₄ 中的局部电荷密度》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Intra-unit-cell Josephson scanning tunneling spectroscopy of the cuprate Bi₁.₂Pb₀.₈Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Intra-unit-cell Josephson scanning tunneling spectroscopy of the cuprate Bi₁.₂Pb₀.₈Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04815v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The predominantly dₓ^₂₋y^₂-wave pairing symmetry of cuprate superconductors is well established, yet its microscopic manifestation in local Cooper-pair tunneling remains less explored. Here, we investigate Bi₁.₂Pb₀.₈Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ, using Josephson scanning tunneling spectroscopy with a conventional s-wave superconducting Pb tip. We observe a zero-bias conductance enhancement whose approximately quadratic dependence on junction conductance is consistent with phase-diffusive Josephson tunneling. Atomic-resolution conductance maps and site-resolved spectra reveal a pronounced intra-unit-cell modulation, with enhanced Josephson response near oxygen sites and strong suppression near copper sites and along diagonal directions. Microscopic calculations incorporating the bilayer electronic structure and realistic Wannier-based tunneling matrix elements reproduce the observed spatial pattern through interference between pairing contributions of opposite signs. Our results reveal how the sign-changing d-wave superconducting order parameter manifests itself in atomic-scale Josephson tunneling, providing complementary evidence for unconventional pairing symmetry in cuprates.
full_list.summary: The predominantly dₓ^₂₋y^₂-wave pairing symmetry of cuprate superconductors is well established, yet its microscopic manifestation in local Cooper-pair tunneling remains less explored. Here, we invest…

full_list.title_en: Photoinduced topological phase transition in monolayer 1T^prime-MoS₂
full_list.title_zh: 单层 1T^prime-MoS2 中的光致拓扑相变
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2511.15268v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the systematic competition between perpendicular electric field and circularly polarized light in nonequilibrium topological phases of monolayer 1T^prime--MoS₂ using a low-energy k!·!p Hamiltonian and Floquet theory. The off-resonant field generates spin- and valley-dependent mass corrections that reshape the Berry curvature (BC) and shift the conditions for band inversion. By evaluating the quasienergy bands, BC, and spin- valley-resolved Chern numbers, we identify a sequence of light and electric field controlled topological transitions by gap closing. Depending on the Floquet coupling strength and the electric-field parameter, the system evolves between the equilibrium quantum spin Hall (QSH) state and a set of driven phases including spin-polarized quantum Hall insulator (S-QHI), band insulator (BI) and photo-induced quantum Hall insulator (P-QHI) regimes. The results establish 1T^prime--MoS₂ as a tunable platform where circular driving selectively manipulates spin and valley degrees of freedom, enabling controlled access to non-equilibrium topological phases in transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs).
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用低能 k!·!p 哈密顿量和 Floquet 理论研究了单层 1T^prime--MoS2 非平衡拓扑相中垂直电场和圆偏振光之间的系统竞争。非共振场产生与自旋和谷相关的质量校正，从而重塑贝里曲率（BC）并改变能带反转的条件。通过评估准能带、BC和自旋谷解析的陈数，我们确定了一系列光和电场通过间隙闭合控制的拓扑转变。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用低能 k!·!p 哈密顿量和 Floquet 理论研究了单层 1T^prime--MoS2 非平衡拓扑相中垂直电场和圆偏振光之间的系统竞争。非共振场产生与自旋和谷相关的质量校正，从而重塑贝里曲率（BC）并改变能带反转的条件。通过评估准能带、BC和自旋谷解析的陈数，我们确定了一系列光和电场通过间隙闭合控制的拓扑转变。根据 Floquet 耦合强度和电场参数，系统在平衡量子自旋霍尔 (QSH) 状态和一组驱动相之间演化，包括自旋极化量子霍尔绝缘体 (S-QHI)、能带绝缘体 (BI) 和光致量子霍尔绝缘体 (P-QHI) 状态。结果将 1T^prime--MoS2 确立为可调谐平台，其中循环驱动选择性地操纵自旋和谷自由度，从而能够受控地进入过渡金属二硫化物 (TMD) 中的非平衡拓扑相。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Repulsion-Driven Topological Superconductivity in Twisted MoTe₂
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Repulsion-Driven Topological Superconductivity in Twisted MoTe₂
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that a microscopic model of twisted MoTe₂ with screened Coulomb interactions produces topological superconductivity. Using the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) on infinite cylinders, we find that the narrow Chern band of twisted MoTe₂ has Cooper pair correlations that strengthen with cylinder circumference, consistent with two dimensional superconductivity. The superconductor has chiral f-wave pairing around the valley center, and its topology produces chiral Majorana edge modes and non-Abelian vortex cores. At zero displacement field, the superconductor spans fillings -0.78lesssimνlesssim-0.72, close to the experimental range, and extends in a dome to finite displacement field. We then predict how its stiffness evolves with the filling and the tunable displacement field. The interplay with screening length is also examined. Nearby, we find a fractional Chern insulator, a topological charge density wave, a metal, and a charge-ordered state. The last is a candidate for the reentrant integer Hall regime in experiments. These results establish a route from repulsive interactions in microscopic models of moiré materials to chiral topological uperconductors with chiral Majorana edge modes.
full_list.summary: We show that a microscopic model of twisted MoTe₂ with screened Coulomb interactions produces topological superconductivity. Using the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) on infinite cylinders…
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《Repulsion-Driven Topological Superconductivity in Twisted MoTe₂》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: SrMn₂Ge₂: A metallic system with anomalous magnetotransport properties
full_list.title_zh: SrMn2Ge2：具有异常磁输运特性的金属系统
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The structural, electronic, and physical properties of previously unexplored layered tetragonal compound SrMn₂Ge₂ are reported. The compound crystallizes in the ThCr₂Si₂-type structure with a crystallographic parameters c/a ratio of 2.535(3), significantly smaller than those of the related BaMn₂Pn₂ compounds (Pn = P, As, Sb, Bi), indicating enhanced interlayer interaction between the moment-bearing Mn-ions. Magnetic susceptibility measurements suggest an antiferromagnetic ground state with a high Neél temperature Tᵣₘ N > 350~K@. A large and positive magnetoresistance (MR) of approximately 50% is observed at low temperatures, which follows a power-law field dependence with exponent n = 1.50(8). Low-temperature electrical resistivity data reveal Kondo-like features. Heat capacity measurements show no signs of a phase transition below 300~K and further confirm a metallic ground state. Electronic structure calculations reveal a three-dimensional Fermi surface and suggest the presence of substantial electronic correlation effects.
full_list.abstract_zh: 报告了先前未探索的层状四方化合物 SrMn2Ge2 的结构、电子和物理性质。该化合物以 ThCr2Si2 型结构结晶，晶体学参数 c/a 比率为 2.535(3)，明显小于相关的 BaMn2Pn2 化合物 (Pn = P、As、Sb、Bi)，表明承载矩的 Mn 离子之间的层间相互作用增强。磁化率测量表明反铁磁基态具有高尼尔温度 Tᵣₘ N > 350~K@。在低温下观察到约 50% 的大正磁阻 (MR)，其遵循指数 n = 1.50(8) 的幂律场依赖性。

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Tuning the Fermi surface of MoTe₂ by Nb Doping
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.05197v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ab initio calculations and angle-resolved photoemission experiments demonstrate that the bulk and surface electronic structure of Weyl semimetal candidate MoTe2 changes significantly by tuning the chemical potential by less than 0.4 eV. Calculations indicate that several Lifshitz transitions can occur among multiple electron and hole Fermi pockets of differing orbital character. Experiments show that 18% Nb-Mo substitution reduces the occupation of bulk and (001) surface bands, effectively producing a quasi-rigid band shift of simeq 0.2 eV. Orbital character and dimensionality of the bulk bands is examined by soft X-ray angle resolved photoemission with control of the excitation light polarization. Deposition of alkali atoms on the surface produces electron binding energy shifts consistent with increased band filling. The results indicate that multiple regimes of electronic properties can be easily accessed in this versatile, layered material.

full_list.title_en: An Exact QFT/Lattice Map for Fermions
full_list.title_zh: 费米子的精确QFT/晶格图
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05329v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct an exact map between continuum fermion fields and lattice fields in 1+1 dimensions. This map rewrites a continuum Hamiltonian as a lattice Hamiltonian with nearest-neighbor couplings and an infinite-dimensional local Hilbert space. The resulting lattice model reproduces exactly the energy spectrum, global operator algebra, chiral symmetries, and anomalies of the continuum QFT on any finite lattice. Unlike domain wall fermions, truncating the local Hilbert space introduces no extra massless modes, and the entanglement entropy of an interval converges as the truncation is removed. The lattice local algebras are of type I and lie between the type III continuum algebras of nested spatial regions, in accordance with the split property. We demonstrate this construction explicitly for N Majorana fermions, realizing the O(N)_LtimesO(N)_R lattice chiral symmetry. We also construct an exact lattice model for the Schwinger model and numerically reproduce the mass gap e/sqrtπ.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们在 1+1 维度上构建了连续费米子场和晶格场之间的精确映射。该映射将连续哈密顿量重写为具有最近邻耦合和无限维局部希尔伯特空间的格子哈密顿量。由此产生的晶格模型准确地再现了任何有限晶格上连续统 QFT 的能谱、全局算子代数、手征对称性和异常。与域壁费米子不同，截断局部希尔伯特空间不会引入额外的无质量模式，并且当截断被移除时，区间的纠缠熵会收敛。根据分裂性质，格局部代数属于 I 型，位于嵌套空间区域的 III 型连续统代数之间。

full_list.title_en: Topological phase transition of deformed mathbb Z₃ toric code
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Topological phase transition of deformed mathbb Z₃ toric code
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.09107v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate topological phase transitions in a family of deformed mathbb Z₃ toric-code wavefunctions prepared from a cluster state by local deformations and projective measurements. Their norms map to the Q=3 Potts model for single-parameter deformations and to a three-state Ashkin--Teller-like (AT₃) construction with two independent four-spin couplings in the general case. Projected entangled-pair-state (PEPS) and variational uniform matrix-product-state (VUMPS) calculations identify the toric-code (TC) phase and phases in which electric (e) anyons are confined or condensed. These phases are separated by critical structures with central charges c=4/5, 8/5, and isolated c=1 antiferromagnetic (AFM) endpoints. A normalized finite-distance e-anyon pair-state norm provides a Fredenhagen--Marcu-type check of the confinement boundary, while the topological data of the quantum double D(mathbb Z₃) imply a topological entanglement entropy γ=log3 throughout the gapped toric-code phase. Relative to the mathbb Z₂ case, the absence of sign-change folding leaves the AFM endpoints unfolded, and the extreme deformation reaches square ice with an emergent U(1) one-form symmetry, Hilbert-space fragmentation, and exact scar configurations.

full_list.title_en: Altermagnetism-induced higher-order topological Dirac semimetals in two-dimensional nonsymmorphic systems
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Altermagnetism-induced higher-order topological Dirac semimetals in two-dimensional nonsymmorphic systems
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04347v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose an altermagnetism-induced route to a two-dimensional higher-order topological Dirac semimetal in a trilayer nonsymmorphic Dirac system. Interlayer hybridization preserves the nonsymmorphic bulk Dirac crossings and generates helical edge states in the trilayer phase. Introducing outer-layer d-wave altermagnetic order gaps the helical edge states, while only the symmetry-protected Dirac crossing at high-symmetry point M remains gapless. The resulting phase hosts a surviving bulk Dirac point, gapped edge spectra, and corner states. An exact layer-space decomposition further reveals that these features arise from the coexistence of a gapless Dirac sector and a gapped Z₂ topological sector. Our results establish altermagnetism as an effective mechanism for engineering higher-order topological Dirac semimetals in two-dimensional nonsymmorphic systems.

full_list.title_en: Correlated quantum criticality and topological magnetoelectric response in Bi2Se3
full_list.title_zh: Bi2Se3 中相关的量子临界性和拓扑磁电响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A defining feature of quantum materials is that multiple orders govern low-energy physics and are not independent. We study Bi₂Se₃ by combining DFT with a renormalized correlated honeycomb model in which frustrated magnetic order and helical topological surface states are coupled via one control parameter. The surface states map to a honeycomb Hubbard model with frustrated J₁--J₂ exchange. Exact diagonalization up to 20 sites shows the Néel structure factor and valence-bond-solid order parameter cross at J₂/J₁ approx 0.22, agreeing with QMC/DMRG, and a dynamical spin structure factor broadens near the crossover, as expected for a spinon continuum. Band inversion of the renormalized tight-binding model occurs on the same critical locus, producing jumps in the Chern number and Z₂ invariant mirrored by the skyrmion charge Q. This gives a microscopic link: Q selects the axion angle and thus the topological magnetoelectric coupling. We distinguish axion coupling, independent of skyrmion helicity, from the helicity-dependent magnetoelectric multipole coupling, whose toroidal component scales as sinγ and vanishes for Néel-type textures. We derive the Q-topological magnetoelectric energy and estimate sim 10⁻²⁰,J per skyrmion per cycle for few-tesla fields. The cycle is thermodynamically bounded: constant-θ cycles extract no net work, and efficiency is limited by axionic entropy change.

full_list.title_en: Current control of spin-wave transport in YIG via the smallVO₂ insulator-to-metal transition
full_list.title_zh: 通过小 VO2 绝缘体到金属转变对 YIG 中自旋波输运的电流控制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04951v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrically reconfigurable spin-wave transport is central to realizing energy-efficient magnonic information technologies, yet existing current-driven approaches require current densities that undermine the fundamental dissipation advantage of spin-wave-based signal processing. Here, we demonstrate low-power electrical control of spin-wave propagation in a hybrid magnonic device comprising a low-damping yttrium iron garnet (YIG) film coupled to an adjacent vanadium dioxide (smallVO₂) stripe. Passing a small current through smallVO₂ triggers its insulator-to-metal transition (IMT), producing a sharp, reversible resistivity reduction exceeding three orders of magnitude. This abrupt phase transition locally modifies the spin-wave dispersion in YIG, reducing the group velocity and suppressing transmission by up to 40 dB near the ferromagnetic resonance frequency. Pulsed current excitation enables reconfiguration of spin-wave transport on a 10 ms timescale. Temperature-dependent measurements, corroborated by thermal modeling, decouple the respective contributions of current-induced heating of YIG and the IMT in smallVO₂, establishing the latter as the dominant control mechanism. Our results demonstrate that electrically induced phase transitions in correlated oxides constitute an energy-efficient strategy for dynamic spin-wave manipulation, providing a scalable route toward reconfigurable magnonic devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电可重构自旋波传输是实现节能磁波信息技术的核心，但现有的电流驱动方法所需的电流密度破坏了基于自旋波的信号处理的基本耗散优势。在这里，我们演示了混合磁振器件中自旋波传播的低功率电控制，该器件包括与相邻二氧化钒（小VO 2）条带耦合的低阻尼钇铁石榴石（YIG）薄膜。让小电流通过小VO2会触发其绝缘体到金属的转变（IMT），从而产生超过三个数量级的急剧、可逆的电阻率降低。

full_list.title_en: Dynamics of Vortex Electrons in a Uniform Magnetic Field Across Nonrelativistic and Relativistic Regimes
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dynamics of Vortex Electrons in a Uniform Magnetic Field Across Nonrelativistic and Relativistic Regimes
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04162v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The dynamics of a vortex electron in a transverse uniform magnetic field involves not only the cyclotron motion of the wave packet center but also the evolution of its internal wavefunction structure. To study this process, we develop a quantum framework and investigate the dynamics of vortex electrons in both the nonrelativistic and relativistic regimes. A discrete Bessel-Gaussian initial wave packet is expanded in the basis of Dirac eigenstates to obtain the time-dependent wavefunction and to analyze its spatiotemporal evolution. In the nonrelativistic regime, the results deviate significantly from the rigid point-dipole model, as the intrinsic kinetic orbital angular momentum exhibits dynamics more complex than simple Larmor precession, owing to the nonstationary internal current distribution of the wave packet. In the relativistic regime, the nonlinear dependence of the energy levels on the quantum numbers destroys the equal spacing of the spectrum. Consequently, the relative phases among the eigenstate components of the wave packet evolve nonuniformly, resulting in wave-packet spreading and deformation, accompanied by modified intrinsic orbital angular momentum dynamics. We introduce a dimensionless parameter to quantify this relativistic dephasing, providing an approximate criterion for selecting physical parameters and evolution times to mitigate the resulting wave-packet distortion. These results clarify the limitations of the rigid point-dipole model, highlight the essential role of internal wavefunction structure, and provide theoretical guidance for understanding and manipulating relativistic vortex electrons.

full_list.title_en: Effect of compensation on magnetic ordering in (Ga,Mn)As
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Effect of compensation on magnetic ordering in (Ga,Mn)As
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The real mechanism of ferromagnetism in III-V diluted magnetic semiconductors such as Ga₁₋ₓMnₓAs is still debated. The experimental results point out the realization of appreciable ferromagnetism at filling of the impurity band close to one-half that can be expressed in terms of compensation degree. Based on our recent results on the existence of two competing mechanisms of pair indirect exchange (with ferro- and antiferro alignment of Mn d shells), a theory of magnetic ordering in (Ga,Mn)As is presented. The molecular-field-like equation is derived in which the effective exchange constant contains all necessary information about material, including the Mn content, the compensation degree, the crystal coordination, and the parameters of two competing pair exchange interactions. The Curie temperature depends crucially on the compensation degree. Depending on Mn content and compensation degree, three possible magnetic phases (paramagnetic, ferromagnetic, and spin-glass-like) are predicted. However, the spin-glass-like phase in (Ga,Mn)As is apparently not realized due to the additional inevitable compensation caused by As antisites. The phase transition into the ferromagnetic state occurs not only with Mn content variation but through the change of the compensation degree as well. The new mechanism of photoferromagnetic effect is predicted and discussed in the context of possible clarification of the magnetic ordering mechanism. It is assumed that the main obstacle to a possible increase in the Curie temperature is the increasing contribution of the antiferromagnetic superexchange between the nearest-neighbor Mn's, rather than compensatory (electric or magnetic) effects from Mn interstitials, as was previously stated. The comparison of our predictions with available experimental data is presented.

full_list.title_en: Emergence of Berry curvature dipole and nonlinear Hall effect in a novel hexagonal borophosphene allotrope
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Emergence of Berry curvature dipole and nonlinear Hall effect in a novel hexagonal borophosphene allotrope
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the electronic structure, local orbital coupling, and strain-tunable nonlinear Hall response of two arsenic-substituted borophosphene-derived monolayers, As@MBP and As@AMBP, using first-principles calculations and tight-binding analysis. In the absence of spin--orbit coupling, both systems exhibit a finite Berry-curvature dipole (BCD) and a substantial nonlinear Hall conductivity, demonstrating that the nonlinear response is intrinsically driven by orbital physics and inversion-symmetry breaking. As substitution opens sizable band gaps of 120~meV in As@MBP and 90~meV in As@AMBP, well exceeding room-temperature thermal fluctuations (kBT approx 25.9~meV). Tight-binding analysis reveals that As incorporation breaks the equivalence of B-P hoppings in As@MBP and induces sign reversals in key nearest-neighbor hoppings in As@AMBP, reflecting a pronounced electronic reconstruction beyond simple geometric effects. Under mechanical strain, the redistribution of Berry curvature yields a maximum BCD of 22~mathringA in As@MBP, approximately 10 times larger than that of unstrained structure, and induces a reversal of the BCD sign. These results establish As-substituted borophosphene derivatives as promising light-element platforms for mechanically switchable nonlinear transport and quantum-material applications without relying on strong spin-orbit coupling.

full_list.title_en: Field-free transverse response in altermagnet and topological insulator heterojunctions
full_list.title_zh: 交流磁体和拓扑绝缘体异质结中的无场横向响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate the transport properties of a topological insulator (TI) connected to two-dimensional altermagnetic (AM) leads in the absence of an external magnetic field. Exploiting the intrinsic time-reversal symmetry breaking of altermagnets, we report the emergence of a field-free transverse differential conductivity in the resulting AM-TI-AM heterostructure. Our analysis reveals that this transverse response is highly sensitive to the orientation of the Néel vector: a finite transverse conductivity manifests when the Néel vector possesses an out-of-plane component, whereas it strictly vanishes for in-plane orientations (θ = π/2) under symmetric chemical potentials (μₜ = μ_b) due to the restoration of symmetry between the k_y and -k_y momentum channels. Conversely, when asymmetric chemical potentials are applied (μₜ ≠ μ_b), this symmetry is broken, yielding a finite transverse response even for an in-plane Néel vector. Furthermore, we demonstrate that while the longitudinal differential conductivity exhibits Fabry-Pérot-type oscillations as a function of the TI's chemical potential, the transverse conductivity displays a distinct antisymmetric dependence. Notably, the oscillatory behavior of the longitudinal conductivity persists even at finite temperatures. Spatially, the transverse current contribution decays exponentially with position inside the TI region. We also find that both the longitudinal and transverse differential conductivity exhibit periodic oscillations with the junction parameter χₜ=χ_b. These findings provide a fundamental understanding of field-free transverse responses in spin-momentum locked boundary states, highlighting the potential of AM-TI heterojunctions for next-generation spintronic applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上研究了在没有外部磁场的情况下连接到二维交流磁 (AM) 引线的拓扑绝缘体 (TI) 的输运特性。利用交流磁体固有的时间反转对称性破缺，我们报告了在所得的 AM-TI-AM 异质结构中出现了无场横向微分电导率。我们的分析表明，这种横向响应对尼尔矢量的方向高度敏感：当尼尔矢量具有面外分量时，会出现有限的横向电导率，而在对称化学势（μₜ = μ_b）下，由于 k_y 和 -k_y 动量通道之间对称性的恢复，横向电导率在对称化学势（μₜ = μ_b）下严格消失。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究了在没有外部磁场的情况下连接到二维交流磁 (AM) 引线的拓扑绝缘体 (TI) 的输运特性。利用交流磁体固有的时间反转对称性破缺，我们报告了在所得的 AM-TI-AM 异质结构中出现了无场横向微分电导率。我们的分析表明，这种横向响应对尼尔矢量的方向高度敏感：当尼尔矢量具有面外分量时，会出现有限的横向电导率，而在对称化学势（μₜ = μ_b）下，由于 k_y 和 -k_y 动量通道之间对称性的恢复，横向电导率在对称化学势（μₜ = μ_b）下严格消失。相反，当应用不对称化学势（μₜ ≠ μ_b）时，这种对称性就会被打破，即使对于面内尼尔矢量也会产生有限的横向响应。此外，我们证明，虽然纵向微分电导率表现出法布里-珀罗型振荡作为 TI 化学势的函数，但横向电导率却表现出明显的反对称依赖性。值得注意的是，即使在有限的温度下，纵向电导率的振荡行为仍然持续。在空间上，横向电流贡献随着 TI 区域内的位置呈指数衰减。我们还发现纵向和横向微分电导率均表现出周期性振荡，结参数 χₜ=χ_b。这些发现提供了对自旋动量锁定边界态中无场横向响应的基本理解，凸显了 AM-TI 异质结在下一代自旋电子应用中的潜力。

full_list.title_en: Non-Hermitian effective dynamics from post-selection protocols
full_list.title_zh: 来自后选择协议的非厄米有效动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03910v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multiple seemingly distinct frameworks are commonly proposed to explain the emergence of effective non-Hermitian dynamics in quantum systems coupled to an environment. Furthermore, it remains contested how to properly calculate expectation values or whether thermal equilibrium states exist in non-Hermitian systems. In this work, we show that Feshbach projection, the Lindblad master equation, and the ancilla approach can all be understood through the Kraus map formalism, leading to non-Hermitian time evolution if an appropriate post-selection procedure is enforced. After first deriving an exact expression for the conditional system dynamics, we discuss the approximations employed in each approach and the classes of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians that can be obtained. Within this framework, we physically justify the consistency of the right-right formalism (as opposed to the biorthogonal one) for calculating expectation values. Finally, we demonstrate that the traditional notion of thermodynamic equilibrium is not applicable to general non-Hermitian systems. Consequently, stationary states are characterized as non-equilibrium steady states, which should not be conflated with system-projected thermal states of the system-environment composite.
full_list.abstract_zh: 通常提出多个看似不同的框架来解释与环境耦合的量子系统中有效非厄米动力学的出现。此外，如何正确计算期望值或非厄米系统中是否存在热平衡状态仍然存在争议。在这项工作中，我们表明 Feshbach 投影、Lindblad 主方程和辅助方法都可以通过 Kraus 映射形式主义来理解，如果执行适当的后选择程序，则会导致非厄米时间演化。在首先推导出条件系统动力学的精确表达式之后，我们讨论了每种方法中采用的近似以及可以获得的非厄米哈密顿量的类别。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 通常提出多个看似不同的框架来解释与环境耦合的量子系统中有效非厄米动力学的出现。此外，如何正确计算期望值或非厄米系统中是否存在热平衡状态仍然存在争议。在这项工作中，我们表明 Feshbach 投影、Lindblad 主方程和辅助方法都可以通过 Kraus 映射形式主义来理解，如果执行适当的后选择程序，则会导致非厄米时间演化。在首先推导出条件系统动力学的精确表达式之后，我们讨论了每种方法中采用的近似以及可以获得的非厄米哈密顿量的类别。在此框架内，我们从物理上证明了用于计算期望值的右-右形式主义（与双正交形式主义相对）的一致性。最后，我们证明传统的热力学平衡概念不适用于一般的非厄米系统。因此，静止状态被表征为非平衡稳态，不应将其与系统-环境复合材料的系统预测热状态混为一谈。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量, 热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《来自后选择协议的非厄米有效动力学》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Resolving magnetic order and dynamics with polarized neutron scattering: a practical guide to longitudinal polarization analysis
full_list.title_zh: 用极化中子散射解析磁序和动力学：纵向极化分析实用指南
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neutron scattering provides microscopic information on magnetic order and spin dynamics. Most experiments, however, use unpolarized neutrons and do not fully exploit the information carried by the neutron spin. Longitudinal polarization analysis (LPA), established in the pioneering work of Moon, Riste, and Koehler at Oak Ridge National Laboratory in the late 1960s, separates magnetic and nonmagnetic scattering contributions through their different effects on the neutron spin. In this review, we illustrate how LPA can distinguish weak magnetic scattering from nonmagnetic contributions, constrain small moment components, and resolve the spin-space anisotropy of magnetic excitations. We introduce the formalism connecting measured polarization channels to magnetic quantities and discuss scattering geometry, crystallographic projections, and corrections for finite polarization. Our aim is to provide a practical guide for neutron scatterers using LPA to determine magnetic structures and characterize spin excitations in quantum materials. We conclude with opportunities in altermagnets, unconventional superconductors, and kagome magnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 中子散射提供有关磁序和自旋动力学的微观信息。然而，大多数实验使用非极化中子，并没有充分利用中子自旋携带的信息。纵向极化分析 (LPA) 是由 Moon、Riste 和 Koehler 于 20 世纪 60 年代末在橡树岭国家实验室的开创性工作中建立的，通过磁性和非磁性散射对中子自旋的不同影响来区分它们。在这篇综述中，我们阐述了 LPA 如何区分弱磁散射和非磁贡献，约束小矩分量，并解决磁激励的自旋空间各向异性。

full_list.title_en: Thermally enhanced magnon-phonon resonance in van der Waals antiferromagnet FePS3
full_list.title_zh: 范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中的热增强磁振子共振
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04229v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong coupling between collective excitations provides a route to controlling quantum states of matter, yet its evolution under thermal fluctuations remains poorly understood. In the van der Waals antiferromagnet FePS3, strong magnon-phonon coupling is established at low temperatures. At the same time, recent terahertz experiments revealed the counterintuitive stabilization of a long-lived metastable magnetic state with an exceedingly long lifetime of 5 msec at the antiferromagnetic transition, not at the base temperature. This was attributed to a strongly coupled spin-lattice scenario, challenging the conventional wisdom that increased magnetic and thermal fluctuations near TN should be detrimental to the coherent control of a metastable phase. Thus it requires an independent examination for correct understanding. Using high-field Raman spectroscopy, we systematically investigate the temperature evolution of magnon-phonon coupling in FePS3. We observe a pronounced avoided crossing between magnon and phonon modes across a wide range of temperatures and find that the coupling strength remains remarkably robust with increasing temperatures. The zero-field magnon-phonon detuning decreases progressively with warming, driving the system toward resonance and thereby enhancing their hybridization near the transition temperature. This anomalous thermal evolution provides the crucial key to understanding the unusual terahertz-driven states recently reported in FePS3. More broadly, our results highlight van der Waals magnets as a promising platform for strong coupling among collective excitations and for controlling magnetic states through light-matter interactions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 集体激发之间的强耦合提供了控制物质量子态的途径，但其在热波动下的演化仍然知之甚少。在范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中，在低温下建立了强磁振子耦合。与此同时，最近的太赫兹实验揭示了一种反直觉的长期亚稳态磁态稳定性，其在反铁磁转变时而不是在基础温度下具有 5 毫秒的超长寿命。这是由于强耦合的自旋晶格场景，挑战了传统观点，即 TN 附近增加的磁和热波动应该不利于亚稳态相的相干控制。因此，需要进行独立检查才能正确理解。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 集体激发之间的强耦合提供了控制物质量子态的途径，但其在热波动下的演化仍然知之甚少。在范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中，在低温下建立了强磁振子耦合。与此同时，最近的太赫兹实验揭示了一种反直觉的长期亚稳态磁态稳定性，其在反铁磁转变时而不是在基础温度下具有 5 毫秒的超长寿命。这是由于强耦合的自旋晶格场景，挑战了传统观点，即 TN 附近增加的磁和热波动应该不利于亚稳态相的相干控制。因此，需要进行独立检查才能正确理解。利用高场拉曼光谱，我们系统地研究了 FePS3 中磁振子-声子耦合的温度演化。我们观察到在很宽的温度范围内明显避免了磁振子模式和声子模式之间的交叉，并发现随着温度的升高，耦合强度仍然非常强大。零场磁振子-声子失谐随着变暖而逐渐减小，驱动系统共振，从而增强它们在转变温度附近的杂化。这种反常的热演化为理解最近在 FePS3 中报道的不寻常的太赫兹驱动状态提供了关键的关键。更广泛地说，我们的结果强调了范德华磁体作为集体激发之间强耦合以及通过光-物质相互作用控制磁态的有前途的平台。

full_list.title_en: Thermodynamic Evidence for Multiple Field-Induced Phases in an Anisotropic Kagome Antiferromagnet
full_list.title_zh: 各向异性 Kagome 反铁磁体中多个场感应相的热力学证据
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kagome antiferromagnets are predicted to host exotic field-induced phases, yet experimental identification of their thermodynamic signatures remains challenging. Here we combine specific heat (C) and ultrasound measurements up to 36 T and down to 0.5 K to map the H-T phase diagram of the anisotropic kagome magnet Y₃Cu₉(OH)₁₉Cl₈. We show that the suppression of long-range antiferromagnetic order with field at sim 15 T approximately coincides with the onset of the unconventional 1/6 (or 1/9) magnetization plateau previously observed in this system. The attenuation (and sound velocity) then intriguingly increases down to 0.5 K just at μ₀H = 15 T, and C/T becomes temperature independent. Moreover, our measurements are consistent with the opening of a spin gap Δ₀simeq3.5± 0.3 K within the plateau and reveal a further compressible (ungapped) phase beyond the plateau phase, unveiling a rich sequence of field-induced phases in this quantum magnet.
full_list.abstract_zh: Kagome 反铁磁体预计会具有奇异的场诱导相，但对其热力学特征的实验识别仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将比热 (C) 和高达 36 T 和低至 0.5 K 的超声波测量结合起来，绘制各向异性 Kagome 磁体 Y₃Cu₉(OH)₁₉Cl₈ 的 H-T 相图。我们表明，在 sim 15 T 处场对长程反铁磁有序的抑制大约与先前在该系统中观察到的非常规 1/6（或 1/9）磁化平台的开始一致。
