full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《各向异性 Kagome 反铁磁体中多个场感应相的热力学证据》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Unconventional magnetoelectric conductivity and electrochemical response from dipole-like sources of Berry curvature
full_list.title_zh: 来自浆果曲率偶极子样源的非常规磁电导率和电化学响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.08844v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the longitudinal magnetoelectric conductivity and nonlinear electrochemical response (ECR) of three-dimensional nodal-ring semimetals, including vortex nodal-rings (VNRs) and PT-symmetric nodal-rings (PTNRs), together with three-band Hopf semimetals (HSMs), using the semiclassical Boltzmann formalism. The nodal-rings of the VNRs and PTNRs lie in the k_z=0 plane, whereas the nodal points of HSMs host isolated Berry-curvature (BC) dipoles with axes along the k_z direction. In VNRs, such dipoles may be viewed as forming a continuous distribution along the nodal-ring, connecting the two classes of systems. For collinear electric and magnetic (B) fields along the anisotropy axis boldsymbol hatz, the linear response is computed exactly and displays odd powers of B_z for a single ring or node. For a two-node HSM with oppositely-oriented BC-dipole axes, these odd terms cancel in the sum. We analyse the nonlinear ECR, described by third-rank response tensors that relate the current to the combined action of an electric field and a chemical-potential gradient. The surviving tensor components are determined by the tilt direction of the bandstructure, and we obtain explicit results for simultaneous in-plane and axial tilts. A comparison of the three systems reveals a close correspondence between the responses of VNRs and HSMs, while PTNRs behave qualitatively differently. We attribute these similarities and differences to the topology of the BC field, namely dipole-like sources in VNRs and HSMs versus the ring-confined BC structure of PTNRs.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用半经典玻尔兹曼形式，研究了三维节点环半金属的纵向磁电导率和非线性电化学响应（ ECR ） ，包括涡旋节点环（ VNR ）和PT对称节点环（ PTNR ） ，以及三频段霍普夫半金属（ HSM ）。VNR和PTNR的节点环位于k_z = 0平面，而HSMS的节点点托管沿k_z方向轴的孤立浆果曲率（ BC ）偶极子。在VNR中，这种偶极子可被视为沿节点环形成连续分布，连接两类系统。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用半经典玻尔兹曼形式，研究了三维节点环半金属的纵向磁电导率和非线性电化学响应（ ECR ） ，包括涡旋节点环（ VNR ）和PT对称节点环（ PTNR ） ，以及三频段霍普夫半金属（ HSM ）。VNR和PTNR的节点环位于k_z = 0平面，而HSMS的节点点托管沿k_z方向轴的孤立浆果曲率（ BC ）偶极子。在VNR中，这种偶极子可被视为沿节点环形成连续分布，连接两类系统。对于沿各向异性轴粗体符号hatz的共线电场和磁场（ B ）场，精确计算线性响应，并显示单个环或节点的B_z的奇数幂。对于具有相反方向的BC-偶极轴的双节点HSM ，这些奇项在求和中抵消。我们分析非线性ECR ，由三阶响应张量描述，该张量将电流与电场和化学势梯度的组合作用相关联。剩余张量分量由带状结构的倾斜方向决定，我们得到了平面和轴向同时倾斜的显式结果。三个系统的比较揭示了VNR和HSM的反应之间的密切对应关系，而PTNR的行为在性质上有所不同。我们将这些相似性和差异性归因于BC场的拓扑结构，即VNR和HSM中的偶极子源与PTNR的环限制BC结构。

full_list.title_en: Disentangling Spin Pumping and Two-Magnon Scattering Contributions to Gilbert Damping in YIG/V Bilayers
full_list.title_zh: 解开自旋泵和双磁散射对YIG/V双层中Gilbert阻尼的贡献
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.29597v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we investigate the magnetic damping and spin pumping response of YIG-based bilayers incorporating vanadium (V) as the normal metal layer via broadband ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) measurements as a function of YIG thickness. We show that the apparent enhancement of the Gilbert damping in YIG/V bilayers cannot be solely attributed to spin pumping. Instead, two-magnon scattering (TMS) plays a dominant role in governing the thickness dependence of the damping in the nanometer regime. By applying a thickness-dependent damping model that accounts for both spin pumping and two-magnon scattering contributions, we successfully disentangle the different relaxation contributions. Our analysis reveals that neglecting two-magnon scattering leads to an overestimation of the spin-pumping contribution and consequently to unphysically large values of the effective spin-mixing conductance. After isolating the intrinsic spin pumping contribution, we extract a thickness-independent effective spin-mixing conductance of guparrowdowⁿarrowₑff = 1.33 × 10¹⁸~mathrmm⁻². These findings provide a more accurate framework for quantifying spin transport parameters in FM/HM systems and emphasize the necessity of accounting for extrinsic damping mechanisms when interpreting spin pumping and inverse spin Hall effect experiments.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过宽带铁磁共振（ FMR ）测量研究了结合钒（ V ）作为正常金属层的YIG基双层的磁阻尼和自旋泵浦响应，作为YIG厚度的函数。我们表明， YIG/V双层中Gilbert阻尼的明显增强不能仅归因于自旋泵。相反，双磁场散射（ TMS ）在控制纳米级阻尼的厚度依赖性方面发挥着主导作用。通过应用同时考虑自旋泵浦和双磁散射贡献的厚度相关阻尼模型，我们成功地解开了不同的弛豫贡献。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们通过宽带铁磁共振（ FMR ）测量研究了结合钒（ V ）作为正常金属层的YIG基双层的磁阻尼和自旋泵浦响应，作为YIG厚度的函数。我们表明， YIG/V双层中Gilbert阻尼的明显增强不能仅归因于自旋泵。相反，双磁场散射（ TMS ）在控制纳米级阻尼的厚度依赖性方面发挥着主导作用。通过应用同时考虑自旋泵浦和双磁散射贡献的厚度相关阻尼模型，我们成功地解开了不同的弛豫贡献。我们的分析显示，忽略双磁散射会导致自旋泵浦贡献的高估，从而导致有效自旋混合电导的非物理大值。在分离出固有自旋泵的贡献后，我们提取了与厚度无关的guparrowdow的有效自旋混合电导= 1.33 × 10 ¹ ”~ mathrmm”。这些发现为量化FM/HM系统中的自旋传输参数提供了更准确的框架，并强调了在解释自旋泵和逆自旋霍尔效应实验时考虑外部阻尼机制的必要性。

full_list.title_en: Exact Rokhsar-Kivelson points hosting first-order phase transitions in S=1 compass models
full_list.title_zh: S=1 罗盘模型中承载一阶相变的精确 Rokhsar-Kivelson 点
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study S=1 compass models on the square and kagome lattices with bond-dependent bilinear and biquadratic interactions parametrized by an angle θ. For compatible geometries, we determine the exact ground-state manifolds throughout the interval π/4≤θ≤3π/4. At each endpoint, a product of on-site unitaries maps the Hamiltonian to the Laplacian of a configuration graph G in the S=1 Cartesian basis. These endpoints are exact Rokhsar-Kivelson (RK) points, with one ground state per dynamically connected component of G. Each such state is an equal-amplitude superposition in the transformed basis and acquires configuration-dependent phases upon transforming back to the original basis. Both models possess m=O(L) independent and mutually commuting conserved Z₂ line charges, where L is the linear system size, forcing a ground-state degeneracy of at least 2^m at the RK endpoints. Throughout the interior region, π/4<θ<3π/4, the ground-state manifold on each lattice is instead spanned by two product states, both annihilated by the Hamiltonian. On both lattices, each RK endpoint also hosts a first-order transition into this intervening interior phase spanned by the two product states with long-range order.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了方形和 kagome 晶格上的 S=1 罗盘模型，其具有由角度 θ 参数化的键相关双线性和双二次相互作用。对于兼容的几何形状，我们确定整个区间 π/4≤θ≤3π/4 的精确基态流形。在每个端点，现场幺正的乘积将哈密顿量映射到 S=1 笛卡尔基础上配置图 G 的拉普拉斯算子。这些端点是精确的 Rokhsar-Kivelson (RK) 点，G 的每个动态连接分量都有一个基态。每个这样的状态都是变换后基中的等幅叠加，并在变换回原始基时获取配置相关的相位。

full_list.title_en: Magnetic ground states of CrPS₄ and NiPS₃ monolayers from long-range exchange interactions
full_list.title_zh: 来自远程交换相互作用的CrPS和NiPS单层的磁性基态
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.20631v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the magnetic properties of monolayer CrPS₄ and NiPS₃ by combining first-principles calculations, second-principles spin models, and Monte Carlo simulations. Unlike conventional approaches that truncate exchange interactions after only a few shells and determine them by fitting total energies, we extract the magnetic exchange tensors directly from density functional theory using the LKAG formalism and include interactions until numerical convergence is achieved. We show that long-range exchange interactions qualitatively modify the magnetic behavior of both materials. In CrPS₄, they destabilize the previously predicted ferromagnetic ground state and stabilize a spin-spiral phase, reducing the critical temperature to about 21,K, in agreement with available experiments. The resulting magnetic phase diagram contains multiple collinear and non-collinear phases that can be tuned by temperature and external magnetic fields. In NiPS₃, the experimentally observed zigzag antiferromagnetic order only emerges when exchange interactions up to the fifth shell are included. These results demonstrate that quantitatively predictive spin models for thiophosphate monolayers require long-range exchange interactions and provide a predictive framework for accurately describing two-dimensional van der Waals magnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 通过结合第一原理计算、第二原理自旋模型和蒙特卡罗模拟，我们研究了单层CrPS和NiPS的磁性。与仅在少数壳体后截断交换相互作用并通过拟合总能量来确定它们的传统方法不同，我们使用LKAG形式直接从密度泛函理论中提取磁交换张量，并包括相互作用，直到实现数值收敛。我们表明，远程交换相互作用定性地改变了两种材料的磁性行为。在CrPS中，它们破坏了先前预测的铁磁基态并稳定了自旋螺旋相，将临界温度降低到约21 ， K ，这与现有实验一致。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Matrix-Element Estimators for Spin-Coupled Generalized Valence Bond (SCGVB) Wavefunctions
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantum Matrix-Element Estimators for Spin-Coupled Generalized Valence Bond (SCGVB) Wavefunctions
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.12045v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Valence-bond wavefunctions such as spin-coupled generalized valence bond (SCGVB) provide compact and chemically interpretable descriptions of strong correlation, but their nonorthogonal determinant structure makes quantum evaluation of overlaps and Hamiltonian matrix elements difficult. Here we introduce an ancilla-free, measurement-driven framework that reformulates these quantities as vacuum expectation values of Pauli-string operators, enabling evaluation with shallow circuits, local Clifford rotations, and computational-basis measurements, without controlled operations. We validate the method for H₄ along a dissociation pathway and for a 70-determinant C₂ active-valence benchmark. The reconstructed matrices agree with the classical Löwdin-based reference, while Chirgwin-Coulson weights remain chemically consistent. These results establish the proposed estimators as a low-depth, circuit-compatible formulation for evaluating SCGVB matrix elements, while making no claim of quantum computational advantage.

full_list.title_en: Triboelectric nanogenerators across length scales: linking materials, multiscale modelling and applications
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Triboelectric nanogenerators across length scales: linking materials, multiscale modelling and applications
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04008v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) convert low-frequency mechanical energy into electricity and enable self-powered sensing. Their performance depends on interactions among material properties, surface morphology, contact mechanics, charge generation and external circuits. This review examines these interactions across length scales to assess how material and interface descriptions support predictive device design. Polymeric, inorganic, composite and natural materials are discussed in relation to charge generation and retention, mechanical compliance, durability and application requirements. Modelling approaches span molecular dynamics and first-principles calculations, rough-surface contact mechanics, device-scale electrostatics and equivalent circuits. Their capabilities are assessed through the inputs they require, the quantities they predict and the experimental evidence used for validation. Particular attention is given to prescribed surface charge density, idealised geometries and nominal contact-area assumptions, which constrain predictions under realistic loading conditions. Applications are organised by macroscale, milliscale and microscale device dimensions to examine requirements for materials, architecture and integration. The review identifies evolving real contact area and contact-dependent charge generation and decay as critical links between interfacial behaviour and electrical output. A staged validation strategy is proposed for contact mechanics, electrostatics and circuit response, with independent testing beyond calibration conditions. These priorities guide the development of multiscale models and reliable TENG systems.

full_list.title_en: Bond-valence theory is a general electrostatic valence rule
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Bond-valence theory is a general electrostatic valence rule
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05339v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pauling's electrostatic valence rule assigns to each bond of a cation of charge z with n anion neighbors the strength z/n. Bond-valence theory replaces the equal split of valence among bonds by s=exp[(R₀-d)/B] in the bond length d and takes the sum rule, that the valences at each atom add to its formal charge, as its first axiom. Here the bond valence is defined in the electron density. Atomic basins of a first-principles density are bounded by faces, one per bond critical point, and the electric flux of that density through a face is a charge associated with the bond. The fluxes leaving a cation sum to its basin charge by Gauss's law, so on this surface the sum rule is a theorem. Across 3680 oxides, halides, chalcogenides and pnictides the flux follows the bond-valence law site by site, with a median deviation of ten percent. The softness B varies nearly an order of magnitude from stiff sulfides to softer arsenides. In all cases it is set by the electrostatic flux at atomic basin faces. R₀ then follows from the bond lengths and their differences. Anion valences equal those of bonded cations to within 5% for most of the oxide, fluoride, sulfide and nitride sites. Transferability of (R₀,B) between compounds fails in 96 of 106 families, suggesting that the softness is a local site property defined by the basin charge rather than a transferable constant of a given cation--anion pair. Eliminating B by the sum rule gives s=(z/n)⁽R₀⁻d⁾/⁽R₀⁻d_B⁾, Pauling's strength raised to a distance exponent at the softness-weighted mean bond length d_B. Thus, bond-valence theory is Pauling's rule with a distance exponent, and the electron density supplies the surface on which the two are equivalent.

full_list.title_en: A Resonant-Tunneling Quantum-Dot Demultiplexer for Scalable Cryogenic Single-Electron Routing
full_list.title_zh: 用于可扩展低温单电子路由的谐振隧道量子点解复用器
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling quantum electronic systems such as quantum-dot spin qubits and single-electron devices is increasingly limited by the wiring overhead between cryogenic devices and room-temperature control electronics. Multi-channel quantum-dot architectures that selectively route electrons using a few shared control lines, analogous to demultiplexers in classical networks, offer a promising solution. Here, we propose and theoretically investigate a gate-defined architecture of three parallel quantum dots sharing a common source reservoir and coupled to independent drain channels. Using an analytical electrostatic model and tight-binding quantum transport simulations, we show that the device can act as an on-chip single-electron demultiplexer based on resonant tunneling in the cryogenic regime. Closed-system eigenstate analysis reveals localized orbital states in each dot, and open-system transport calculations show resonant conductance peaks when these levels align with the incident electron energy, consistent with the closed-system eigenenergy evolution. By engineering the barrier-gate spacing and the relative plunger-gate dimensions, we obtain well-separated resonances with minimal overlap between channels. Bond-current density calculations show that transport is confined to the resonant channel with negligible leakage into neighboring outputs, yielding channel selectivity approaching unity for all resonant modes. The architecture is compatible with Si/SiGe and GaAs/AlGaAs platforms and can be extended to more channels, offering a route toward programmable quantum routing and resonant-tunneling-based quantum circuitry.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子点自旋量子位和单电子器件等量子电子系统的扩展越来越受到低温器件和室温控制电子器件之间布线开销的限制。多通道量子点架构使用一些共享控制线选择性地路由电子，类似于经典网络中的解复用器，提供了一种有前途的解决方案。在这里，我们提出并从理论上研究了共享公共源库并耦合到独立漏通道的三个并行量子点的栅极定义架构。使用分析静电模型和紧束缚量子传输模拟，我们表明该器件可以充当基于低温状态下共振隧道的片上单电子解复用器。

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：An example of universal braiding in Links--Gould topological quantum computation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04290v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct a universal quantum computational encoding via braiding in Links--Gould fusion spaces associated to U_q^H(mathfraksl(2|1)) where q is on the unit circle and is not a root of unity. The construction uses only neglectons and is realized in the morphism spaces HomU_q^H(V(0,α),V(0,-frac12)otⁱmes ²Notimes V(0,α)). Under explicit positivity and arithmetic constraints these spaces admit a 2^N-dimensional computational subspace with a positive definite Hermitian form. We prove single-qubit density in U(2,1) and approximate arbitrary unitary operators on N-qubit computational subspaces with arbitrarily small leakage. The calculations use explicit inclusions, projections, and Hermitian pairings without requiring F-matrices.

full_list.title_en: Asymptotic electromagnetic transition conditions for thin layers: the arithmetic-mean field and susceptibility hybridization
full_list.title_zh: 薄层的渐近电磁跃迁条件：算术平均场和磁化率杂化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04324v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Effective transition conditions that replace a thin polarizable layer by a zero-thickness sheet are commonly applied in electromagnetic models of two-dimensional (2D) materials and metasurfaces. These conditions usually take the arithmetic mean of the fields on either side as the polarizing field at the boundary, and characterize the layer by the 0^th moment of its susceptibility, but both choices are typically imposed rather than derived. We derive transition conditions for a finite-thickness, in-plane homogeneous, in-plane isotropic layer with a general nonlocal susceptibility, using a single-scale asymptotic expansion in η = lmax(k₀,q), where l is the layer thickness, k₀ the free-space wavenumber and q the in-plane wavenumber. The sheet limit must be taken after resumming the out-of-plane depolarizing field, as this ensures that the resulting sheet susceptibility is independent of the material thickness. The arithmetic mean then emerges as the leading-order polarizing field for general susceptibility profiles. Asymmetries in the layer profile modify the effective susceptibility appearing in the transition conditions, rather than altering the arithmetic-mean field prescription. If the spatial profile is not even in both out-of-plane coordinates, in-plane and out-of-plane response hybridize, turning the diagonal volumetric susceptibility into a q-dependent effective tensor surface susceptibility with off-diagonal components. Mirror symmetry alone does not remove this hybridization. Comparison with exact solutions for local and separable layers shows that the derived conditions remain accurate to O(η) across propagating and evanescent excitations, whereas the standard sheet conditions fail once hybridization becomes appreciable.
full_list.abstract_zh: 用零厚度片材代替薄极化层的有效转变条件通常应用于二维 (2D) 材料和超表面的电磁模型中。这些条件通常将两侧场的算术平均值作为边界处的极化场，并通过其磁化率的第 0 阶矩来表征层，但这两种选择通常都是强加的而不是导出的。我们使用 η = lmax(k₀,q) 中的单尺度渐近展开式推导了具有一般非局域磁化率的有限厚度、面内均匀、面内各向同性层的转变条件，其中 l 是层厚度，k₀ 是自由空间波数，q 是面内波数。

full_list.title_en: Coexisting Kondo and Weyl-like transport in kagome heavy-fermion metal, Yb_yCo₃Ge₃₋ₓSnₓ
full_list.title_zh: kagome重费米子金属Yb_yCo₃Ge₃₋ₓSnₓ中共存的Kondo和类Weyl输运
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03822v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong electron correlations and topology offer complementary routes to controlling electrical conduction, as correlations can make electrons heavy (e.g. Kondo lattices) whereas topology can make them behave as massless particles (e.g. Dirac or Weyl systems), and having both in one material is rare. In Kondo lattice systems, Kondo hybridization between localized 4f and conduction electrons strongly enhances the quasiparticle mass, where in Weyl-Kondo systems these Kondo-renormalized bands form Weyl states, and simultaneous signs of both Kondo and Weyl states in one material have not been observed in transport. Here we report signs of both in the kagome metal ceYb_yCo3Ge₃₋ₓSnₓ by combining magnetotransport, heat capacity, magnetization, angle-resolved and X-ray photoemission spectroscopy, and DFT+U calculations to reveal Yb-dependent Kondo scattering developing into lattice coherence, with extrapolated Sommerfeld coefficient of approximately 2 ~JmolYb⁻¹K⁻². Transverse magnetoresistance (MR) follows single-ion Kondo scaling, whereas longitudinal transport contains an additional negative response proportional to B² and remains unsaturated up to 32 T, consistent with a chiral anomaly. These findings support a picture of Kondo and Weyl-like conduction arising from distinct electronic states without external Fermi-level tuning, suggesting a possible route to combining correlated and topological functionality in a bulk material.

full_list.title_en: Collective Modes of Fractional States Beyond Landau Levels
full_list.title_zh: 朗道能级以上分数态的集体模态
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03805v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collective modes provide a powerful probe into the properties and stability of topologically ordered and strongly interacting phases of matter, such as fractional quantum Hall states. Yet, the description of fractional-state excitations away from the Landau-level limit remains a formidable challenge. We develop a framework for describing collective excitations in the strong-coupling regime of coupled-wire constructions and show that they emerge as solitons and breathers of effective sine-Gordon theories. This approach provides a systematic route to studying collective modes in a broad class of fractional states. Applied to a coupled-wire construction of the fractional quantum Hall effect, the framework captures key features of the magnetoroton branch. It naturally extends to fractional Chern insulators, demonstrating that magnetoroton-like collective modes persist well beyond the Landau-level limit. We find that the magnetoroton gap increases as the Fubini-Study metric approaches the ideal (trace-condition) limit, highlighting the important role of quantum geometry in the stability of fractionalized phases and their collective excitations. The same trend favors the stability of the long-wavelength quadrupolar mode associated with the chiral graviton. Together, these results identify a distinct interplay between fractionalization and quantum geometry, and provide an analytical framework for studies of collective excitations in fractional topological matter.
full_list.abstract_zh: 集体模式为拓扑有序和强相互作用的物质相（例如分数量子霍尔态）的性质和稳定性提供了有力的探索。然而，描述远离朗道能级极限的分数态激发仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。我们开发了一个框架来描述耦合线结构的强耦合机制中的集体激励，并表明它们作为有效正弦戈登理论的孤子和呼吸器出现。这种方法为研究广泛的分数状态中的集体模式提供了一条系统的途径。该框架应用于分数量子霍尔效应的耦合线结构，捕获了磁转子分支的关键特征。它自然地扩展到分数陈绝缘体，证明类似磁旋子的集体模式持续远远超出朗道能级极限。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 集体模式为拓扑有序和强相互作用的物质相（例如分数量子霍尔态）的性质和稳定性提供了有力的探索。然而，描述远离朗道能级极限的分数态激发仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。我们开发了一个框架来描述耦合线结构的强耦合机制中的集体激励，并表明它们作为有效正弦戈登理论的孤子和呼吸器出现。这种方法为研究广泛的分数状态中的集体模式提供了一条系统的途径。该框架应用于分数量子霍尔效应的耦合线结构，捕获了磁转子分支的关键特征。它自然地扩展到分数陈绝缘体，证明类似磁旋子的集体模式持续远远超出朗道能级极限。我们发现，随着富比尼研究度量接近理想（迹线条件）极限，磁转子间隙增加，突出了量子几何在分数化相及其集体激发的稳定性中的重要作用。同样的趋势有利于与手性引力子相关的长波长四极模式的稳定性。总之，这些结果确定了分数化和量子几何之间的独特相互作用，并为分数拓扑物质中集体激发的研究提供了分析框架。

full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《朗道能级以上分数态的集体模态》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Constraining the Superconducting Gap of Monolayer FeSe/SrTiO₃ via Statistical Analysis and Tip-Height-Dependent Tunneling Spectroscopy
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Constraining the Superconducting Gap of Monolayer FeSe/SrTiO₃ via Statistical Analysis and Tip-Height-Dependent Tunneling Spectroscopy
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03978v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monolayer FeSe grown on SrTiO₃ (001) exemplifies interface-enhanced superconductivity, exhibiting a transition temperature nearly ten times that of bulk FeSe. Yet, its tunneling spectra lack clearly identifiable superconducting coherence peaks, preventing an unambiguous determination of the gap magnitude. Here, we use ultralow-temperature scanning tunneling spectroscopy as a function of temperature, tip-sample separation, and lateral position to disentangle tunneling contributions by statistical analysis. Decay rates extracted by regression of tip-height-dependent spectroscopy reveal three energy regimes: Andreev-reflection-dominated tunneling below 6 meV, mixed Andreev and quasiparticle tunneling between 6 and 13 meV, and predominantly quasiparticle tunneling above 13 meV. Spatially resolved spectroscopy and correlation analysis further reveal that the tunneling conductance is predominantly localized near defects below 6 meV but becomes spatially extended at higher energies. Together, these results constrain the superconducting gap to lie between 6 and 13 meV. Our findings establish statistical analysis of spectroscopy as a powerful approach to constraining superconducting gap structures when complex spectral features prevent the unambiguous identification of coherence peaks.

full_list.title_en: Continuum Dirac Theory and Nonlinear Extensions of a Chain of Alternating non-linear springs: an SSH version of the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou model
full_list.title_zh: 连续统狄拉克理论和交替非线性弹簧链的非线性扩展：Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou 模型的 SSH 版本
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A mechanical version of the SSH model, made of equal masses joined by two alternating non-linear springs is studied in the continuum limit. Such a non-linear dimerized mechanical chain generates a nonlinear, dispersive, two-field hyperbolic system of Boussinesq type of differential equations, describing coupled acoustic and gapped optical fields. The corresponding Lagrangian density is found, revealing that the acoustic and optical degrees of freedom are coupled through a structure that is formally analogous to a synthetic spin-orbit coupling, where the spatial motion is locked to the internal sublattice degree of freedom. An emergent non-Abelian Berry connection term also appears. Some particular solitary-wave solutions are found using variational theory, as the effective optical field obeys an undamped and unforced cubic-quintic Duffing equation. Near the Brillouin-zone edge, the system becomes a nonlinear Dirac field theory of the Soler type, providing a direct mechanical realization of interacting relativistic solitons. By factoring out fast spatial oscillations, an effective Jackiw-Rebbi Hamiltonian is obtained, with topological zero modes at domain walls. These modes are akin to the electronic flat bands in moire graphene systems associated with superconductivity and charge fractionalization. Finally, we discuss the mechanical rigidity transition and its effects on the fields as the system evolves toward the fully dimerized limit, in which the zero modes are floppy modes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在连续介质极限下研究了 SSH 模型的机械版本，该模型由两个交替的非线性弹簧连接的相等质量组成。这种非线性二聚机械链生成布辛涅斯克型微分方程的非线性、色散、双场双曲系统，描述耦合的声场和间隙光场。找到了相应的拉格朗日密度，揭示了声学和光学自由度是通过一种形式上类似于合成自旋轨道耦合的结构耦合的，其中空间运动被锁定到内部亚晶格自由度。还出现了一个新兴的非阿贝尔贝里连接项。使用变分理论找到了一些特定的孤立波解，因为有效光场服从无阻尼且无受迫的三次五次杜芬方程。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在连续介质极限下研究了 SSH 模型的机械版本，该模型由两个交替的非线性弹簧连接的相等质量组成。这种非线性二聚机械链生成布辛涅斯克型微分方程的非线性、色散、双场双曲系统，描述耦合的声场和间隙光场。找到了相应的拉格朗日密度，揭示了声学和光学自由度是通过一种形式上类似于合成自旋轨道耦合的结构耦合的，其中空间运动被锁定到内部亚晶格自由度。还出现了一个新兴的非阿贝尔贝里连接项。使用变分理论找到了一些特定的孤立波解，因为有效光场服从无阻尼且无受迫的三次五次杜芬方程。在布里渊区边缘附近，系统变成索勒型非线性狄拉克场论，提供相互作用的相对论孤子的直接机械实现。通过分解快速空间振荡，获得有效的 Jackiw-Rebbi 哈密顿量，在畴壁处具有拓扑零模式。这些模式类似于莫尔石墨烯系统中与超导性和电荷分级相关的电子平带。最后，我们讨论了当系统向完全二聚极限演化时，机械刚性转变及其对场的影响，其中零模式是软盘模式。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《连续统狄拉克理论和交替非线性弹簧链的非线性扩展：Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou 模型的 SSH 版本》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Critical amplitudes of the Baxter-Wu model from MCPA and Wolff simulations: free-exponent and fixed-exponent fits
full_list.title_zh: MCPA 和 Wolff 模拟中的 Baxter-Wu 模型的临界振幅：自由指数和固定指数拟合
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The two-dimensional Baxter-Wu model belongs to the universality class of the four-state Potts model. Exact expressions are available for its energy, specific heat, magnetization, and polarization amplitudes. We use these results as a benchmark for evaluating two simulation algorithms and two approaches to extracting critical amplitudes. Microcanonical population annealing (MCPA) and the sublattice-freezing Wolff algorithm yield highly consistent estimates for the energy and order parameters when applied to lattices of comparable size. According to the exact Joyce series, the local effective exponent does not stabilize at a constant value but instead undergoes a monotonic drift. This behaviour stems from corrections to scaling, which can be expressed as a series in the cube root of the reduced temperature. As a result, these corrections decay relatively slowly, with the leading term being of relative order |t|²/³. When performing a fit with a free exponent on an automatically identified plateau, this drift gets incorporated into the estimated exponent, introducing a substantial bias in the derived amplitudes. In contrast, a fit that fixes the exponent to its exact value and explicitly accounts for the analytic correction series delivers a close match to the known exact amplitudes. Using this refined fitting approach, we obtain estimates for the susceptibility amplitudes and the universal amplitude ratios. These values are in good agreement with predictions from form-factor calculations. Additionally, we numerically determine the leading correction coefficient for the polarization.
full_list.abstract_zh: 二维Baxter-Wu模型属于四态Potts模型的普适类。其能量、比热、磁化强度和极化幅度都有精确的表达式。我们使用这些结果作为评估两种仿真算法和两种提取临界幅度的方法的基准。当应用于大小相当的晶格时，微正则布居退火 (MCPA) 和亚晶格冻结 Wolff 算法可以对能量和有序参数产生高度一致的估计。根据精确的乔伊斯级数，局部有效指数不会稳定在恒定值，而是经历单调漂移。这种行为源于对标度的修正，可以表示为降低温度的立方根的级数。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 二维Baxter-Wu模型属于四态Potts模型的普适类。其能量、比热、磁化强度和极化幅度都有精确的表达式。我们使用这些结果作为评估两种仿真算法和两种提取临界幅度的方法的基准。当应用于大小相当的晶格时，微正则布居退火 (MCPA) 和亚晶格冻结 Wolff 算法可以对能量和有序参数产生高度一致的估计。根据精确的乔伊斯级数，局部有效指数不会稳定在恒定值，而是经历单调漂移。这种行为源于对标度的修正，可以表示为降低温度的立方根的级数。因此，这些修正的衰减速度相对较慢，主导项的相对阶数为 |t|²/³。当在自动识别的平台上使用自由指数进行拟合时，这种漂移会被纳入估计的指数中，从而在导出的幅度中引入很大的偏差。相反，将指数固定为其精确值并明确考虑解析校正级数的拟合可提供与已知精确幅度的紧密匹配。使用这种精细的拟合方法，我们获得了磁化率幅度和通用幅度比的估计值。这些值与形状因数计算的预测非常一致。此外，我们还以数值方式确定了偏振的主要校正系数。

full_list.title_en: Dissipationless valley diode effects in Kekulé graphene superlattices
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dissipationless valley diode effects in Kekulé graphene superlattices
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04396v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconducting diodes have attracted considerable interest for nonreciprocal device applications owing to their dissipationless transport. Here, we theoretically propose that a tunnel junction based on the Kekulé graphene superlattice can host a finite valley supercurrent that exhibits pronounced nonreciprocity even in the absence of superconductivity, giving rise to a dissipationless valley diode effect. This effect originates from the additional reflection phase acquired by electrons in each transverse channel and supports perfect valley diode rectification with 100% efficiency, which can be readily tuned via the gate voltage. This finding provides a platform for designing dissipationless valleytronics in a more versatile manner.

full_list.title_en: Engineering Fractional Topological Superconductors: Numerical Bogoliubov-de Gennes Analysis for Parafermion Realization in FCI-Superconductor Heterostructures
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Engineering Fractional Topological Superconductors: Numerical Bogoliubov-de Gennes Analysis for Parafermion Realization in FCI-Superconductor Heterostructures
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.16025v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a pathway to engineer Z3 parafermion zero modes in fractional Chern insulator-superconductor heterostructures. Using numerical Bogoliubov-de Gennes calculations and edge-theory analysis, we demonstrate how realistic materials such as MoTe2/NbSe2 can host parafermionic excitations with experimentally accessible signatures, including fractional Josephson effects, localized zero modes, interferometry, and thermal transport. Our work outlines concrete strategies for experimentally accessing parafermionic excitations in FCI-superconductor heterostructures.

full_list.title_en: Ferron polariton Hall effect: Deflecting optically rectified polarization with magnetic fields
full_list.title_zh: 铁氧体极化子霍尔效应：用磁场偏转光整流偏振
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferrons are elementary excitations of ferroelectric order that can propagate and transport polarization when excited with light. Here, we show theoretically that ferron polaritons exhibit a Hall effect: an applied magnetic field generates polarization transport perpendicular to the propagation direction of a ferron polariton excited by an incident terahertz pulse. We demonstrate this effect for the example of ferroelectric SnTe using first-principles calculations and a microscopic theory of the phonon-polariton current. The direction and magnitude of the transverse polarization transport can be controlled by the polarization of the terahertz pulse and the applied magnetic field. Our results establish a route toward light-controlled directional transport of electric polarization in ferroelectrics.

full_list.title_en: Field-induced first order quantum phase transition of the superconducting order parameter in Ising superconductors with Rashba spin-orbit coupling
full_list.title_zh: 具有 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的伊辛超导体中超导有序参数的场致一阶量子相变
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.01910v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ising superconductors have attracted significant attention recently due to their resilience against magnetic fields far beyond the Pauli-paramagnetic limit as well as their broader role as a platform for exploring the interplay of spin-orbit coupling, valley degrees of freedom and superconducting pairing in two-dimensional materials. Their protection against external magnetic field relies on strong Ising spin-orbit coupling, which originates from in-plane inversion symmetry breaking. Due to the heavy atom nature of Ising SCs, a smaller but sizable Rashba SOC can arise from gating or interfacial effects. Here, we study Rashba spin-orbit coupling within a two-valley model of Ising superconductors with an attractive s-wave interaction. We show that Rashba SOC induces a first order quantum phase transition in Ising superconductors. At low temperatures, this means the superconducting order parameter vanishes abruptly in the vicinity of the quantum critical point. This effect, however, disappears at high temperatures. Our findings demonstrate that the low- and high temperature physics of Ising SCs are quantitatively and qualitatively different in the two-valley model.
full_list.abstract_zh: 伊辛超导体最近引起了极大的关注，因为它们对远远超出泡利顺磁极限的磁场的抵抗能力，以及它们作为探索二维材料中自旋轨道耦合、谷自由度和超导配对相互作用的平台的更广泛作用。它们对外部磁场的保护依赖于强伊辛自旋轨道耦合，这种耦合源于面内反演对称性破缺。由于 Ising SC 的重原子性质，门控或界面效应可能会产生较小但相当大的 Rashba SOC。在这里，我们研究具有吸引力的 s 波相互作用的伊辛超导体双谷模型内的 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 伊辛超导体最近引起了极大的关注，因为它们对远远超出泡利顺磁极限的磁场的抵抗能力，以及它们作为探索二维材料中自旋轨道耦合、谷自由度和超导配对相互作用的平台的更广泛作用。它们对外部磁场的保护依赖于强伊辛自旋轨道耦合，这种耦合源于面内反演对称性破缺。由于 Ising SC 的重原子性质，门控或界面效应可能会产生较小但相当大的 Rashba SOC。在这里，我们研究具有吸引力的 s 波相互作用的伊辛超导体双谷模型内的 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合。我们证明 Rashba SOC 在伊辛超导体中引发一级量子相变。在低温下，这意味着超导有序参数在量子临界点附近突然消失。然而，这种效应在高温下消失。我们的研究结果表明，伊辛 SC 的低温和高温物理在双谷模型中在数量和质量上都有所不同。

full_list.title_en: Forecasting Low-Dimensional Navier-Stokes equations via Multi-Dimensional Hybrid Quantum Reservoir Computing
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Forecasting Low-Dimensional Navier-Stokes equations via Multi-Dimensional Hybrid Quantum Reservoir Computing
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2509.04006v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The prediction of complex dynamics remains an open problem across many domains of physics, where nonlinearities and multiscale interactions severely limit the reliability of conventional forecasting methods. Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) has emerged as a promising paradigm for information processing by exploiting the high dimensionality of the Hilbert space, where the dynamics of quantum systems take place. Here, we introduce a hybrid quantum-classical reservoir architecture capable of handling multivariate time series through quantum evolution combined with classical memory enhancement. Our model employs a five-qubit transverse-field Ising Hamiltonian with input-modulated dynamics and temporal multiplexing, enabling the encoding of input signals over multiple timescales. We apply this framework to two paradigmatic models of chaotic behavior in fluid dynamics, where multiscale dynamics and nonlinearities play a dominant role: a low-dimensional truncation of the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations and the Lorenz-63 system. By systematically scanning the quantum system's parameter space, we identify regions that maximize forecasting performance, as measured by the Valid Prediction Time. The observed robustness and reliable performances for both dynamical systems suggest that this hybrid quantum approach offers a flexible platform for modelling complex nonlinear time series.

full_list.title_en: Hidden Triakontadipole Order in the Triangular-Lattice Magnet CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉
full_list.title_zh: 三角晶格磁体 CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉ 中隐藏的 Triakontadipole 顺序
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The absence of magnetic Bragg peaks and a broad excitation continuum are commonly recognized experimental features of a quantum spin liquid. The Ce-based triangular-lattice hexaaluminate CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉ exhibits both signatures, yet its effective model and ground state remain under debate. Experiments have variously suggested a quantum spin liquid, proximate umbrella point, and disorder-suppressed magnetic order. Here we trace these contradictions to an overlooked multipolar degree of freedom: the transverse pseudospin of the |±5/2rangle Kramers doublet is a rank-5 triakontadipole rather than an ordinary dipole. Analyzing the magnetization, neutron spectra, and thermodynamics on equal footing, we establish a dipole-triakontadipole XXZ model with Jₚₑᵣₚ simeq 0.65 K and J_c simeq -0.13 K. The resulting planar triakontadipolar superfluid order is hidden from dipolar probes, explaining the absence of a magnetic Bragg peak in neutron scattering. The zero-field excitations separate into a low-energy triakontadipole wave and a broad higher-energy continuum. We further propose nuclear spin-lattice relaxation and spin-current experiments to probe the gapless excitations of this hidden triakontadipole superfluid. Our findings thus open a new avenue for high-rank multipolar physics in rare-earth triangular-lattice magnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 不存在磁性布拉格峰和宽的激发连续体是量子自旋液体普遍公认的实验特征。 Ce基三角晶格六铝酸盐CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉表现出这两个特征，但其有效模型和基态仍存在争议。实验从不同角度提出了量子自旋液体、近似伞点和无序抑制磁序。在这里，我们将这些矛盾追溯到一个被忽视的多极自由度：|±5/2rangle Kramers 双峰的横向赝自旋是 5 级三触偶极子，而不是普通偶极子。

full_list.title_en: Improving the Dynamic Range of Interacting Quantum Sensors via Optimized Quantum Control
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Improving the Dynamic Range of Interacting Quantum Sensors via Optimized Quantum Control
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2505.04958v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Interacting spin ensembles are promising platforms for quantum sensing, but spin-spin interactions can induce complex, nonmonotonic responses to external fields, limiting the dynamic range over which the fields can be estimated unambiguously. Here, we propose a quantum-circuit-learning-inspired method to improve the dynamic range of interacting quantum sensors using optimized global control fields. We consider an ensemble of dipole-coupled spins subjected to an inhomogeneous magnetic field generated by an electric current. By optimizing the global control fields applied during sensing, we train the expectation value of the collective magnetization to approximate a prescribed monotonic target function. We also introduce a penalty on the magnetization variance to account for measurement fluctuations. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the optimized control can substantially enlarge the dynamic range compared with sensing without control. We further investigate the trade-off between dynamic range and estimation uncertainty and show that the variance penalty can reduce the uncertainty at the expense of dynamic range. These results demonstrate that learning-assisted global control provides a promising approach to improving the performance of interacting quantum sensors.

full_list.title_en: Interaction-driven Weyl superfluids from topologically trivial bands in an optical Raman lattice
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Interaction-driven Weyl superfluids from topologically trivial bands in an optical Raman lattice
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a scheme to realize Weyl superfluidity from topologically trivial bands in the strongly correlated regime of a three-dimensional optical Raman lattice. The scheme builds on a pairing mechanism arising from the interplay between a large Zeeman splitting and strong Hubbard interaction. Spin-flip hopping suppressed by the large Zeeman detuning is resonantly restored when the attractive Hubbard interaction compensates the energy mismatch, yielding a correlated spin-orbit coupling that depends on the local particle configuration. Combining this density-dependent in-plane spin-orbit coupling with density-dependent spin-conserving interlayer tunneling extends the pairing mechanism to three dimensions. A self-consistent mean-field treatment of the microscopic model yields Weyl superfluids with two, four, or eight nodes, together with fully gapped weak topological superfluids. Tuning the interaction strength and particle filling drives transitions between these phases and controls the number of Weyl nodes. We further propose an experimental implementation with ultracold ⁴⁰K atoms. Our results highlight density-assisted spin-orbit coupling as a mechanism for realizing Weyl superfluidity in strongly correlated systems.

full_list.title_en: Intrinsic non-Markovian magnetisation dynamics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Intrinsic non-Markovian magnetisation dynamics
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.07378v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Memory effects are widespread in complex systems while evidence of non-Markovian dynamics in fundamental physical systems has been limited to specifically engineered cases. Here we report on the experimental observation of non-Markovian magnetisation dynamics in crystalline cobalt. Intense terahertz electromagnetic driving brings the system into a non-equilibrium state, and allows us to follow its magnetisation dynamics in real time at low temperatures. The response reveals a striking multi-peaked frequency spectrum that defies conventional descriptions. Using open quantum system theory we evidence that a non-Markovian memory kernel, arising from spin-phonon bath coupling, naturally explains both the spectral structure and its temperature dependence. Theoretical prediction of the spectrum is accomplished by simulating the non-Markovian Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation, while analytics quantitatively determines the frequencies of three spectral peaks. The results demonstrate that intrinsic memory effects can emerge in a simple ferromagnet, opening new opportunities to explore and control non-Markovian dynamics in condensed-matter systems.

full_list.title_en: Kekulé Superconductivity Induced by Quantum Geometry in Haldane Phases
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Kekulé Superconductivity Induced by Quantum Geometry in Haldane Phases
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2508.21791v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Chiral two-dimensional electron gases, which capture the electronic properties of graphene and rhombohedral graphene systems, exhibit singular momentum-space vortices and are susceptible to interaction-induced topological Haldane phases. Here, we investigate pairing interactions in the inversion-symmetric Haldane phases of chiral two-dimensional electron gases. We demonstrate that the nontrivial band topology of the Haldane phases enhances intra-valley (Qq = ± 2 Kk_D) pair susceptibility relative to inter-valley (Qq = 0) pair susceptibility, favoring the emergence of a lattice-scale pair-density wave order. When longitudinal acoustic phonons mediate the pairing interaction, the system supports a chiral Kekulè superconducting order at low densities. At higher densities, the phase diagram depends on the parity of the Chern number J. For even parity, an s-wave Kekulè order appears, while for odd parity we find a Qq =0 valley triplet chiral-J and a valley singlet s-wave order at different densities. Our findings are relevant to superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene and Kagome metals.

full_list.title_en: Korringa factor in Dirac-nodal-line systems
full_list.title_zh: 狄拉克节点线系统中的科林加因子
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Korringa factor K(α) in the nuclear magnetic resonance studies is a widely used measure of electron-correlation effects in metals and is conventionally interpreted using the non-correlated value K(α) = 1. In Dirac-fermion systems, however, the non-correlated reference value depends on the electronic density of states (DOS) and differs from that of conventional metals. Here, we theoretically investigate the non-correlated Korringa factor K^*(α) in a Dirac nodal-line (DNL) system with finite nodal-line dispersion using a DOS-based approach. We show that K^*(α) exhibits an intrinsic temperature dependence, continuously evolving from the Dirac-fermion value of 1.71 at high temperatures to the metallic value of 1 at low temperatures. The crossover temperature is found to be proportional to the nodal-line dispersion width, identified as the characteristic energy scale governing the non-correlated Korringa factor in DNL systems. We further demonstrate that Landau quantization generates singular DOS structures that strongly enhance K^*(α), producing pronounced peaks even in the absence of electron correlations. In addition, K^*(α) exhibits two distinct types of magnetic oscillations arising from intra-level and inter-level contributions. The latter originates from the overlap of singular points belonging to positive and negative quantum-number Landau subbands at the Fermi level and represents a unique consequence of the finite energy dispersion of a DNL. These results provide a quantitative reference for interpreting NMR experiments in DNL materials and for identifying genuine correlation effects beyond DOS-induced contributions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 核磁共振研究中的 Korringa 因子 K(α) 是金属中电子相关效应的广泛使用的度量，通常使用非相关值 K(α) = 1 进行解释。然而，在狄拉克费米子系统中，非相关参考值取决于电子态密度 (DOS)，并且与常规金属的电子态密度不同。在这里，我们使用基于 DOS 的方法从理论上研究了具有有限节点线色散的狄拉克节点线 (DNL) 系统中的非相关 Korringa 因子 K^*(α)。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 核磁共振研究中的 Korringa 因子 K(α) 是金属中电子相关效应的广泛使用的度量，通常使用非相关值 K(α) = 1 进行解释。然而，在狄拉克费米子系统中，非相关参考值取决于电子态密度 (DOS)，并且与常规金属的电子态密度不同。在这里，我们使用基于 DOS 的方法从理论上研究了具有有限节点线色散的狄拉克节点线 (DNL) 系统中的非相关 Korringa 因子 K^*(α)。我们证明 K^*(α) 表现出内在的温度依赖性，从高温下的狄拉克费米子值 1.71 不断演变到低温下的金属值 1。研究发现，交叉温度与节点线色散宽度成正比，节点线色散宽度被确定为控制 DNL 系统中不相关 Korringa 因子的特征能量尺度。我们进一步证明朗道量子化产生奇异的 DOS 结构，该结构强烈增强 K^*(α)，即使在没有电子相关性的情况下也会产生明显的峰值。此外，K^*(α) 表现出由层内和层间贡献引起的两种不同类型的磁振荡。后者源于属于费米能级正负量子数朗道子带的奇点的重叠，代表了 DNL 有限能量色散的独特结果。这些结果为解释 DNL 材料中的 NMR 实验以及识别 DOS 引起的贡献之外的真正相关效应提供了定量参考。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《狄拉克节点线系统中的科林加因子》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Lattice spin systems coupled to a compact U(1) gauge field with negative gauge coupling favoring frustration
full_list.title_zh: 晶格自旋系统与紧凑的 U(1) 规范场耦合，负规范耦合有利于挫败
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03837v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the phase diagram and nature of the phase transitions of three-dimensional compact lattice Abelian Higgs models with negative gauge coupling. These models describe multicomponent complex scalar fields coupled to a compact U(1) gauge field. Negative gauge coupling favors frustrated plaquette configurations, competing with the tendency of the matter ferromagnetic-like interaction to suppress frustration. Monte Carlo simulations and finite-size scaling analyses of models with one- and two-component scalar fields of unit charge reveal a substantially richer phase structure than at nonnegative gauge coupling. For two components, the O(3) transition line associated with gauge-invariant bilinear ordering extends into the negative-coupling region, and turns into a first-order transition line with decreasing K, toward the fully-frustrated K→ -infty limit. An analogous first-order transition line is also found for the one-component scalar matter with negative gauge coupling. Both one- and two-component models exhibit two additional continuous transition lines at sufficiently large matter coupling. Their energy-cumulant scaling is consistent with three-dimensional Ising and XY critical exponents, suggesting topological transitions in the mathbb Z₂ and XY gauge universality classes, respectively. These results uncover additional phases generated by the competition between matter ordering and dynamical gauge frustration, whose physical characterization remains an open question.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有负规范耦合的三维紧晶格阿贝尔希格斯模型的相图和相变性质。这些模型描述了与紧凑 U(1) 规范场耦合的多分量复标量场。负规范耦合有利于受挫板配置，与物质类铁磁相互作用的趋势竞争以抑制受挫。具有单位电荷的一分量和二分量标量场的模型的蒙特卡罗模拟和有限尺寸尺度分析揭示了比非负规范耦合时更加丰富的相结构。对于两个分量，与规范不变双线性排序相关的 O(3) 过渡线延伸到负耦合区域，并变成 K 逐渐减小的一阶过渡线，朝向完全受抑 K→ -infty 极限。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有负规范耦合的三维紧晶格阿贝尔希格斯模型的相图和相变性质。这些模型描述了与紧凑 U(1) 规范场耦合的多分量复标量场。负规范耦合有利于受挫板配置，与物质类铁磁相互作用的趋势竞争以抑制受挫。具有单位电荷的一分量和二分量标量场的模型的蒙特卡罗模拟和有限尺寸尺度分析揭示了比非负规范耦合时更加丰富的相结构。对于两个分量，与规范不变双线性排序相关的 O(3) 过渡线延伸到负耦合区域，并变成 K 逐渐减小的一阶过渡线，朝向完全受抑 K→ -infty 极限。对于具有负规范耦合的单分量标量物质，也发现了类似的一阶过渡线。一组分和双组分模型在足够大的物质耦合下都表现出两条附加的连续转变线。它们的能量累积标度与三维 Ising 和 XY 临界指数一致，分别表明 mathbb Z2 和 XY 规范通用性类别中的拓扑转变。这些结果揭示了物质排序和动态规范挫折之间的竞争所产生的额外阶段，其物理特征仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

full_list.title_en: Long-range entangled criticality from coherent errors
full_list.title_zh: 相干错误造成的远程纠缠临界性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.03811v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We find that coherent error can induce a phase transition from the clean surface code phase into an extended long-range entangled critical regime with diverging Markov length. To demonstrate this, we establish two general results of independent interest. The first relates topology and quantum information to mixed-state entanglement: we show that when a noise channel acting on a topological code preserves a higher-form symmetry and nonzero coherent information, the noisy state for generic logical input is long-range entangled. The second generalizes the local recovery construction based on finite Markov length to any locally parameterized family, thus encompassing local Lindbladian evolution, coherent errors followed by syndrome dephasing, and thermal states. We apply these results to the honeycomb surface code, in which we find an extended long-range entangled critical regime that is a quasi-long-ranged counterpart of 1-form strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking. As a byproduct of these studies, we relate the conditional mutual information to conductance in a Majorana network model.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们发现相干误差可以引起从干净表面码相到具有发散马尔可夫长度的扩展长程纠缠临界状态的相变。为了证明这一点，我们建立了两个独立利益的一般结果。第一个将拓扑和量子信息与混合态纠缠相关：我们证明，当作用于拓扑代码的噪声通道保留更高形式的对称性和非零相干信息时，通用逻辑输入的噪声状态是长程纠缠。第二个将基于有限马尔可夫长度的局部恢复构造推广到任何局部参数化族，从而涵盖局部 Lindbladian 演化、伴随相位差的相干误差和热状态。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们发现相干误差可以引起从干净表面码相到具有发散马尔可夫长度的扩展长程纠缠临界状态的相变。为了证明这一点，我们建立了两个独立利益的一般结果。第一个将拓扑和量子信息与混合态纠缠相关：我们证明，当作用于拓扑代码的噪声通道保留更高形式的对称性和非零相干信息时，通用逻辑输入的噪声状态是长程纠缠。第二个将基于有限马尔可夫长度的局部恢复构造推广到任何局部参数化族，从而涵盖局部 Lindbladian 演化、伴随相位差的相干误差和热状态。我们将这些结果应用于蜂窝表面代码，其中我们发现了一个扩展的长程纠缠临界状态，它是 1-形式强到弱自发对称性破缺的准长程对应体。作为这些研究的副产品，我们将条件互信息与马约拉纳网络模型中的电导联系起来。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：声子、有限温度和输运性质。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Nonreciprocal charge transport in quantum materials: From superconductors to magnetic systems
full_list.title_zh: 量子材料中的不可逆电荷传输：从超导体到磁系统
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04821v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonreciprocal charge transport, where current flows preferentially in one direction, has become a key topic across quantum materials. This review covers some recent progress in bulk crystals, artificial heterostructures, van der Waals systems, high-temperature superconductors, and magnetic materials. The review discusses both intrinsic origins, such as band-structure effects, and extrinsic ones, including vortex motion, device geometry, and heating artifacts. A central focus is the superconducting diode effect due to its application potential, which shows different critical currents for opposite directions. The review also examines how symmetry breaking, spin-orbit coupling, and magnetic order contribute to the observed responses. However, there remain challenges when many exciting findings lack a unified picture, and the field continues to debate the relative importance of various mechanisms. The review highlights key open questions and suggests future directions, including better experimental standards and device integration. This review aims to give a balanced view of what is known, what is uncertain, and where the field might go next.
full_list.abstract_zh: 不可逆电荷传输（电流优先沿一个方向流动）已成为量子材料的一个关键主题。这篇综述涵盖了块状晶体、人工异质结构、范德华系统、高温超导体和磁性材料方面的一些最新进展。该评论讨论了内在起源（例如能带结构效应）和外在起源（包括涡流运动、器件几何形状和加热伪影）。中心焦点是超导二极管效应，因为它具有应用潜力，在相反方向上显示出不同的临界电流。该综述还研究了对称性破缺、自旋轨道耦合和磁序如何影响观察到的响应。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: On the universality of entanglement entropy in quantum field theory
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：On the universality of entanglement entropy in quantum field theory
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.04238v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The standard definition of entanglement entropy in quantum field theory requires regularizing the entangling surface and factorizing the Hilbert space, which in turn involves a choice of boundary conditions at the regularized surface. This raises two natural questions which are open at present. The first is under what conditions there is a choice of boundary conditions that leads to a unitary map between the original Hilbert space and the factorized one, which is a necessary condition for a well-defined entanglement entropy. The second concerns the situation where there are multiple such choices, in which case the question is whether they all yield the same entropy, or at least the same terms usually referred to as universal. Focusing on topological theories and using three-dimensional Chern-Simons theory as a concrete illustration, we show under specified assumptions that different such choices affect only the non-universal terms in the entropy, such that the remaining terms are universal in this sense as well, while we explicitly demonstrate that boundary conditions corresponding to non-unitary maps can change these terms. We then explain how a similar argument applies to two-dimensional conformal field theories and discuss a condition for universality in general theories.

core_items.title_en: Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics Reveals Grotthuss Transport in Concentrated Electrolytes
core_items.title_zh: 机器学习分子动力学揭示了浓电解质中的 Grotthuss 输运
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.04558v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Proton transfer is responsible for the anomalous high conductivity in acidic or basic aqueous solutions. Yet, the contribution of the proton transfer mechanism to the conductivity of concentrated aqueous solutions is unknown. In this work, we compute the transport properties of KOH(aq) systems with different concentrations, using Molecular Dynamics simulations with a Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP), which includes proton transfer. We quantify the contribution of the proton transfer mechanism to the diffusivities of hydroxide ions and water molecules, and the ionic conductivity and transport numbers of the electrolytes. The contribution is substantial at lower concentrations, but diminishes at very high concentrations.
core_items.abstract_zh: 质子转移是酸性或碱性水溶液中异常高电导率的原因。然而，质子转移机制对浓水溶液电导率的贡献尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们使用分子动力学模拟和机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)（包括质子转移）来计算不同浓度的 KOH(aq) 系统的输运特性。我们量化了质子转移机制对氢氧根离子和水分子扩散性以及电解质的离子电导率和传输数的贡献。在较低浓度下，贡献很大，但在浓度非常高时，贡献会减弱。

core_items.title_en: Altermagnetism-induced Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov superfluids and momentum-selective pairing channels in optical lattices
core_items.title_zh: 交变磁力诱导的 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov 超流体和光学晶格中的动量选择性配对通道
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.04214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the superfluid phases of a two-dimensional degenerate Fermi gas in an optical lattice subject to a dₓy-wave altermagnetic term that couples to the in-plane spin component. The single-particle Hamiltonian generates anisotropic Fermi surfaces for the two pseudo-spin species while maintaining zero net polarization. Using the Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach, we show that this anisotropy favors Cooper pairing at a finite center-of-mass momentum, producing a competition between Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) and Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) pairing and leading to FFLO superfluids. We further examine the effect of a Zeeman-induced spin polarization and find that triplet and singlet pairing channels coexist and compete, resulting in a momentum-selective pairing pattern. Remarkably, this triplet pairing emerges exclusively in the FFLO phase and is entirely absent in the BCS phase. The model is readily realizable in ultracold atoms with current experimental techniques, providing a feasible route for quantum emulation and for studying unconventional superfluid phases.
core_items.abstract_zh: 我们研究了光学晶格中二维简并费米气体的超流体相，该气体受到与面内自旋分量耦合的 dₓy 波交磁项的影响。单粒子哈密顿量为两个赝自旋物种生成各向异性费米表面，同时保持零净极化。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了光学晶格中二维简并费米气体的超流体相，该气体受到与面内自旋分量耦合的 dₓy 波交磁项的影响。单粒子哈密顿量为两个赝自旋物种生成各向异性费米表面，同时保持零净极化。使用 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方法，我们表明这种各向异性有利于有限质心动量下的 Cooper 配对，从而产生 Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) 和 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) 配对之间的竞争，并导致 FFLO 超流体。我们进一步研究了塞曼诱导的自旋极化的影响，发现三重态和单重态配对通道共存并竞争，从而产生动量选择性配对模式。值得注意的是，这种三联体配对仅出现在 FFLO 阶段，而在 BCS 阶段完全不存在。该模型可以利用当前的实验技术在超冷原子中轻松实现，为量子仿真和非常规超流体相的研究提供了可行的途径。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《交变磁力诱导的 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov 超流体和光学晶格中的动量选择性配对通道》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Loss of altermagnetic order and smooth restoration of Kramers' spin degeneracy with increasing temperature in CrSb and MnTe
core_items.title_zh: CrSb和MnTe中随温度升高而变化的磁序的丧失和Kramers自旋退化的平稳恢复
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2603.15035v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We describe how thermally induced spin fluctuations modify the electronic structures of two prototypical altermagnets, CrSb and MnTe, via application of the disordered local moment picture. For both materials, our self-consistent, ab initio calculations demonstrate that local magnetic moments persist on Cr and Mn atoms in their paramagnetic states, necessitating a spin-polarised description of the electronic structure even above the Néel temperature, T_N. Moreover, Kramers' spin degeneracy, which is broken for both materials in their altermagnetic ground states, is shown to be smoothly restored - on the average - as the local moments thermally disorder. In metallic CrSb, this occurs at temperatures well below T_N and the signature effects of its altermagnetism are lost as the magnetic disorder induces heavy smearing of strongly dispersive electronic states around the Fermi energy. By contrast, in semiconducting MnTe, with its band gap largely unaffected by magnetic disorder, the spin degeneracy only returns at temperatures close to and above T_N. We quantify the temperature dependence of the altermagnetic order parameter and the underlying electronic structures of both materials, with implications for their spin transport and spectroscopic properties.
core_items.abstract_zh: 我们描述了热诱导的自旋波动如何通过应用无序局部矩图来改变两个典型替代磁体CrSb和MnTe的电子结构。对于这两种材料，我们自洽的从头计算表明， Cr和Mn原子在顺磁状态下存在局部磁矩，需要对电子结构进行自旋极化描述，甚至高于Néel温度T_N。此外，克莱默斯的自旋退化（ Kramers 'spin degeneracy ）在两种材料的变磁基态下都被打破，平均而言，随着局部时刻的热紊乱，克莱默斯的自旋退化被平稳地恢复。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 我们描述了热诱导的自旋波动如何通过应用无序局部矩图来改变两个典型替代磁体CrSb和MnTe的电子结构。对于这两种材料，我们自洽的从头计算表明， Cr和Mn原子在顺磁状态下存在局部磁矩，需要对电子结构进行自旋极化描述，甚至高于Néel温度T_N。此外，克莱默斯的自旋退化（ Kramers 'spin degeneracy ）在两种材料的变磁基态下都被打破，平均而言，随着局部时刻的热紊乱，克莱默斯的自旋退化被平稳地恢复。在金属CrSb中，这发生在远低于T_N的温度下，并且其改变磁性的特征效应丢失，因为磁性紊乱导致费米能周围强色散电子态的严重涂抹。相比之下，在半导体MnTe中，其带隙基本上不受磁性紊乱的影响，自旋退化仅在接近或高于T_N的温度下返回。我们量化了两种材料的替代有序参数和基础电子结构的温度依赖性，并对其自旋传输和光谱性质产生影响。

core_items.title_en: Chiral Phonons Coupled to Spin-Split Bands in Altermagnetic CrSb and MnTe
core_items.title_zh: 手性声子耦合到Altermagnetic CrSb和MnTe中的自旋分裂带
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2607.04802v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, providing a unique platform where magnetic order, electronic structure and lattice dynamics intertwine. Here, using first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the prototypical altermagnets CrSb and MnTe host locally chiral phonon modes carrying finite phonon angular momentum with a six-lobes f-wave texture in momentum space. Our results show that the chiral lattice motion originates from the pnictogen/chalcogen sublattice, while the altermagnetic spin splitting is generated by the magnetic transition-metal atoms, indicating that chiral lattice dynamics and altermagnetic electronic states originate from different atomic sublattices of the same crystal. In pristine compounds, at each valley, inversion symmetry suppresses the net phonon angular momentum despite local circular atomic motion. We further demonstrate that isoelectronic symmetry lowering induced by chemical substitution lifts this cancellation and generates finite valley phonon chirality, while keeping the altermagnetic nature of the compounds intact. Most importantly, we reveal that chiral phonons couple to momentum-dependent spin-split electronic bands through momentum-dependent electron-phonon interaction, producing characteristic modifications of the electronic structure, possibly accessible by photoemission experiments. Our results establish altermagnets as a promising platform for chiral phononics and spin-selective lattice control.
core_items.abstract_zh: Altermagnet表现出动量依赖的自旋分裂，没有净磁化，提供了一个独特的平台，磁序、电子结构和晶格动力学交织在一起。在这里，使用第一原理计算，我们证明了原型改变磁体CrSb和MnTe在动量空间中承载有限声子角动量的局部手性声子模，具有六瓣f波纹理。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: Altermagnet表现出动量依赖的自旋分裂，没有净磁化，提供了一个独特的平台，磁序、电子结构和晶格动力学交织在一起。在这里，使用第一原理计算，我们证明了原型改变磁体CrSb和MnTe在动量空间中承载有限声子角动量的局部手性声子模，具有六瓣f波纹理。我们的结果表明，手性晶格运动起源于pnictogen/chalcogen亚晶格，而altermagnetic自旋分裂是由磁性过渡金属原子产生的，这表明手性晶格动力学和altermagnetic电子态起源于同一晶体的不同原子亚晶格。在原始化合物中，在每个山谷，反转对称性抑制了净声子角动量，尽管局部环形原子运动。我们进一步证明，由化学取代引起的等电子对称性降低提升了这种抵消，并产生了有限谷声子手性，同时保持了化合物的改变磁性。最重要的是，我们揭示了手性声子通过动量依赖性电子-声子相互作用与动量依赖性自旋分裂电子带耦合，产生电子结构的特征修改，可能通过光发射实验获得。我们的研究结果确立了Altermagnets作为手性声子和自旋选择晶格控制的有前途的平台。

core_items.title_en: Evidence for a Dirac Spin Liquid in the Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet from High-Precision Neural-Network Quantum States
core_items.title_zh: 来自高精度神经网络量子态的 Kagome 海森堡反铁磁体中狄拉克自旋液体的证据
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.05174v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet is a central model in the study of quantum spin liquids, yet its ground-state properties remain unresolved. We perform large-scale variational Monte-Carlo calculations using neural-network quantum states (NQSs) with kagome-geometry-aware message-passing convolution on two-dimensional tori containing up to 300 spins, and achieve exceptionally low variational energies for the kagome model. The spin and dimer structure factors show no evidence of magnetic or valence-bond long-range order. Moreover, the dominant symmetry-resolved spin and dimer correlations exhibit a common scaling behavior consistent with the emergent SO(6) monopole multiplet of the Dirac spin liquid. Finally, the fidelity of the optimized NQSs with Gutzwiller-projected mean-field states increasingly favors the Dirac state over the competing Z₂ candidates as the system size grows. Together, these complementary results provide evidence for a U(1) Dirac spin-liquid ground state in the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet.
core_items.abstract_zh: 自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体是量子自旋液体研究的核心模型，但其基态特性仍未得到解决。我们使用神经网络量子态 (NQS) 和 kagome 几何感知消息传递卷积在包含多达 300 个自旋的二维 tori 上执行大规模变分蒙特卡洛计算，并为 kagome 模型实现极低的变分能量。自旋和二聚体结构因子没有显示出磁性或价键长程有序的证据。此外，主要的对称解析自旋和二聚体相关性表现出与狄拉克自旋液体的新兴 SO(6) 单极多重态一致的常见缩放行为。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体是量子自旋液体研究的核心模型，但其基态特性仍未得到解决。我们使用神经网络量子态 (NQS) 和 kagome 几何感知消息传递卷积在包含多达 300 个自旋的二维 tori 上执行大规模变分蒙特卡洛计算，并为 kagome 模型实现极低的变分能量。自旋和二聚体结构因子没有显示出磁性或价键长程有序的证据。此外，主要的对称解析自旋和二聚体相关性表现出与狄拉克自旋液体的新兴 SO(6) 单极多重态一致的常见缩放行为。最后，随着系统规模的增长，具有 Gutzwiller 投影平均场状态的优化 NQS 的保真度越来越有利于狄拉克状态，而不是竞争的 Z2 候选状态。总之，这些互补的结果为 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体中的 U(1) 狄拉克自旋液体基态提供了证据。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《来自高精度神经网络量子态的 Kagome 海森堡反铁磁体中狄拉克自旋液体的证据》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Benchmarking and advancing machine-learning interatomic potentials for 3C-SiC across equilibrium and extreme conditions
core_items.title_zh: 在平衡和极端条件下对3C-SiC的机器学习原子间电位进行基准测试和推进
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2510.06966v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Several machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have been developed for cubic silicon carbide (3C-SiC). Here, we benchmark seven existing MLIPs against a common set of structural, thermal, defect, radiation-damage, disordered-phase, and computational-performance tests. We also introduce two complementary MLIPs trained on DFT-labeled crystalline, liquid, amorphous, and defective configurations. TGAP, a Gaussian approximation potential based on the verb|soap_turbo| descriptor, provides consistently high accuracy across the sampled configurational space. MTP, a custom moment tensor potential, retains good accuracy across these regimes while offering substantially lower computational cost, GPU acceleration, and access to multi-million-atom simulations. As an application-level test, both potentials remain stable in displacement cascades spanning short-range repulsion, transient disorder, and recrystallization. Overall, MTP emerges as a particularly strong accuracy--cost compromise for large-scale and strongly non-equilibrium simulations of 3C-SiC.
core_items.abstract_zh: 已经针对立方碳化硅 (3C-SiC) 开发了几种机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)。在这里，我们针对一组常见的结构、热、缺陷、辐射损伤、无序相和计算性能测试对七个现有的 MLIP 进行了基准测试。我们还引入了两种互补的 MLIP，它们经过 DFT 标记的晶体、液体、无定形和缺陷配置的训练。 TGAP，基于动词 |soap_turbo| 的高斯近似势描述符，在采样的配置空间中提供一致的高精度。

core_items.title_en: When do machine-learning potentials need a configuration-dependent kernel? Learning long-range interactions with Fourier neural operators
core_items.title_zh: 机器学习潜力何时需要依赖于配置的内核？学习与傅立叶神经算子的远程交互
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.03678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-range interactions in machine-learning interatomic potentials are commonly treated by coupling learned sources through either a prescribed electrostatic kernel or a learned but configuration-independent one. Whether such a kernel suffices depends on the underlying screened interaction. We address this question by using Fourier neural operators (FNOs) to learn how latent source fields, built from the descriptors of a local backbone (here MACE), interact across the simulation cell. For a synthetic ionic system with tunable screening, a prescribed Coulomb kernel underestimates the long-wavelength charge fluctuations by 43% under strong screening, whereas the FNO reproduces them within 3% and recovers 95-99% of the variance of the residual left by the local backbone. A linear FNO, which learns a configuration-independent kernel, performs equally well in the homogeneous case. Under inhomogeneous screening, rearranging the remote medium modulates the coupling between distant ions, a dependence that no configuration-independent kernel can represent. Among the models tested, only the nonlinear FNO responds to this modulation, and its force errors are 27-41% lower than those of configuration-independent models. In first-principles benchmarks of liquid water, lithium lanthanum zirconate, and Au2/MgO(001), MACE-FNO is comparable to a prescribed-kernel model for the bulk systems and more accurate for the interface. It further captures the reversal of the Au2 wetting preference induced by remote Al dopants, with deviations below 5 meV per cell from density functional theory. These results indicate that a configuration-dependent kernel, as learned by FNOs, becomes necessary once the screening medium varies, even though the energy remains quadratic in the charges for a fixed medium.
core_items.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势中的长程相互作用通常通过通过规定的静电核或学习但与配置无关的核耦合学习源来处理。这样的内核是否足够取决于底层的屏蔽交互。我们通过使用傅里叶神经算子 (FNO) 来解决这个问题，以了解根据本地骨干网（此处为 MACE）的描述符构建的潜在源场如何在模拟单元中相互作用。对于具有可调谐屏蔽的合成离子系统，规定的库仑核在强屏蔽下将长波长电荷波动低估了 43%，而 FNO 在 3% 内再现了它们，并恢复了本地主干留下的残差方差的 95-99%。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势中的长程相互作用通常通过通过规定的静电核或学习但与配置无关的核耦合学习源来处理。这样的内核是否足够取决于底层的屏蔽交互。我们通过使用傅里叶神经算子 (FNO) 来解决这个问题，以了解根据本地骨干网（此处为 MACE）的描述符构建的潜在源场如何在模拟单元中相互作用。对于具有可调谐屏蔽的合成离子系统，规定的库仑核在强屏蔽下将长波长电荷波动低估了 43%，而 FNO 在 3% 内再现了它们，并恢复了本地主干留下的残差方差的 95-99%。学习独立于配置的内核的线性 FNO 在同质情况下表现同样出色。在非均匀筛选下，重新排列远程介质会调节远程离子之间的耦合，这是任何与配置无关的内核都无法表示的依赖性。在测试的模型中，只有非线性FNO响应这种调制，其力误差比与配置无关的模型低27-41%。在液态水、锆酸锂镧和 Au2/MgO(001) 的第一性原理基准测试中，MACE-FNO 与体系统的规定内核模型相当，并且界面更准确。它进一步捕获了由远程 Al 掺杂剂引起的 Au2 润湿偏好的逆转，与密度泛函理论相比，每个细胞的偏差低于 5 meV。这些结果表明，一旦屏蔽介质发生变化，即使固定介质的能量仍然是电荷的二次方，FNO 所学到的依赖于配置的内核就变得必要。
